OpenWAM: An Open, Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining WorldModel

World-Action Model pretraining modular stack egocentric data manipulation

简要说明：OpenWAM 提出了一个模块化的世界-动作模型预训练框架，通过解耦设计组件、通过控制实验识别关键原则，并利用自我中心和机器人数据在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上展现出强劲性能。

TLDR: OpenWAM presents a modular framework for pretraining World-Action Models by decoupling design components, identifying key principles through controlled experiments, and demonstrating strong performance on simulation and real-robot manipulation tasks using egocentric human and robot data.

Abstract: World-Action Models inherit world knowledge from video-generative priors, and channel it into executable control signals through embodied experience. Existing systems, however, are monolithic: the generative backbone, visual representation, architecture, information flow, inference procedure, and training data are tightly coupled, obscuring which design choices matter and why. We introduce OpenWAM, an open research stack that turns world-action pretraining into a controlled experimental program. OpenWAM-Infra factorizes the WAM design space into composable modules with unified training, inference, deployment, and evaluation. On this substrate, OpenWAM-Study examines three questions through controlled experiments: what to inherit, how world and action learning interact, and how their synergy scales; and distills three principles: upstream knowledge transfers through a sufficiently capable generative backbone and a compact, information-rich latent space; world-action synergy requires dedicated action capacity, explicit world-to-action information flow, and synchronized joint denoising; and embodied pretraining principally improves out-of-domain generalization, with one-stage co-training over egocentric and robot data integrating world coverage and action grounding. Composing these principles, we build OpenWAM-α, an open WAM pretrained on roughly 6,400 hours of egocentric human and robot data and evaluated across simulation and real-world benchmarks. Across the eight simulation benchmarks and the real-robot experiments, which together span embodiments from single-arm and bimanual manipulation to dexterous hands, OpenWAM-α delivers consistently excellent performance, sustaining its top-tier standing from simulation to the physical world. We release the full stack, including infrastructure, evaluation protocols, pretrained models, and data recipes, to facilitate future research.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型从视频生成先验中继承世界知识，并通过具身体验将其转化为可执行的控制信号。然而，现有系统呈单片式架构：生成主干、视觉表征、架构设计、信息流、推理过程及训练数据紧密耦合，使得关键设计选择及其成因模糊不清。我们提出OpenWAM——一个将世界-动作预训练转化为可控实验项目的开放研究栈。OpenWAM-Infra将WAM设计空间分解为可组合模块，实现统一的训练、推理、部署与评估。在此基座上，OpenWAM-Study通过控制实验探究三个问题：继承何种知识、世界与动作学习如何交互、两者协同效应如何扩展；并提炼出三条原则：上游知识通过能力充分的生成主干与紧凑且信息丰富的潜空间实现传递；世界-动作协同需要专用的动作能力、显式的世界到动作信息流以及同步联合去噪；具身预训练主要改善域外泛化能力，而基于自我中心视角与机器人数据的单阶段联合训练能同时覆盖世界覆盖度与动作锚定。综合这些原则，我们构建了OpenWAM-α——一个基于约6400小时自我中心人类与机器人数据预训练的开放WAM模型，并在仿真与真实世界基准上完成评估。在涵盖单臂操控、双臂操控及灵巧手等不同具身形态的八项仿真基准与真实机器人实验中，OpenWAM-α展现出持续优异的表现，从仿真到物理世界均保持顶尖水平。我们开放了完整技术栈（包括基础设施、评估协议、预训练模型及数据方案），以促进未来研究。

Authors: Yuran Wang, Siqiao Huang, Mingleyang Li, Chenhao Zhang, Jiaqi Liang, Weiyang Jin, Yue Chen, Xuemin Chi, Donghao Zhou, Qize Yu, Yu-Kai Wang, Yuhan Rui, Shenzhe Yao, Zhen Yuan, Zhenhao Shen, Kefei Zhu, Zijie Zhu, Ning Gao, Xiaowei Chi, Guanqi He, Shanghang Zhang, Hao Dong, Lin Shao, Hang Zhao

GIFT: Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning for Efficient Manipulation Policy Adaptation VLA

Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning VLA models zero-initialized convolution goal image generation manipulation policy

简要说明：GIFT 提出一种轻量级微调框架，通过零初始化卷积将生成的目标图像注入预训练的 VLA 模型，以极少的训练显著提升操作策略的效率与鲁棒性。

TLDR: GIFT introduces a lightweight fine-tuning framework that injects generated goal images into pretrained VLA models via zero-initialized convolutions, significantly improving manipulation policy efficiency and robustness with minimal training.

Abstract: Compared with relying solely on initial observations and language instructions, predicting goal images with generative models as high-level visual guidance can significantly enhance the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, most existing foundation models have not systematically incorporated goal image conditioning due to the high computational training cost. To this end, we propose Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a lightweight and efficient fine-tuning framework that seamlessly integrates generated goal images into multiple representative pretrained VLA models. Our approach introduces goal image features into observations via a zero-initialized convolution which progressively grows parameters from zero and prevents harmful noise from disrupting the pretrained policy during fine-tuning. As training proceeds, goal information is gradually incorporated, enabling efficient goal understanding without disrupting model stability. We further introduce a refined image editing method to generate semantically and visually consistent goal images from initial observations and task instructions. Experiments show that goal-aware VLA models achieve substantial performance gains across tasks: with only a single epoch of fine-tuning, GIFT outperforms the base model by 6.0% and 13.4% on two SIMPLER settings, and by 4.7% on LIBERO, demonstrating both efficiency and effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：相比于仅依赖初始观测和语言指令，利用生成模型预测目标图像作为高层视觉引导，可显著增强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的鲁棒性。然而，由于高昂的计算训练成本，现有的大多数基础模型尚未系统性地整合目标图像条件。为此，我们提出目标注入微调（GIFT），这是一种轻量且高效的微调框架，能够将生成的目标图像无缝集成到多个具有代表性的预训练VLA模型中。该方法通过零初始化卷积将目标图像特征引入观测中，该卷积从零开始逐步增长参数，并在微调过程中防止有害噪声干扰预训练策略。随着训练的推进，目标信息被逐步融入，从而在维持模型稳定性的同时实现高效的目标理解。我们进一步引入一种改进的图像编辑方法，从初始观测和任务指令中生成语义与视觉一致的目标图像。实验表明，具备目标感知能力的VLA模型在多项任务上实现了显著性能提升：仅需单轮微调，GIFT在两种SIMPLER设置下分别以6.0%和13.4%的优势超越基础模型，在LIBERO上提升4.7%，充分展现了其高效性与有效性。

Authors: Xiaoyuan Fang, Shuo Feng, Yuxuan Wang, Enhua Cheng, Peng Zhou, Piji Li

ContextFlow: In-Context Flow Matching for Robot Manipulation VLA

in-context imitation learning flow matching robot manipulation multimodal context compression generalization

简要说明：ContextFlow是一种用于情境模仿学习的条件流匹配模型，在LIBERO上优于先前方法，并能在无需微调的情况下泛化到未见过的真实机器人任务。

TLDR: ContextFlow is a conditional flow-matching model for in-context imitation learning that outperforms prior methods on LIBERO and generalizes to unseen real-robot tasks without fine-tuning.

Abstract: Although highly effective in vision and language domains, applying in-context learning to robotics remains challenging. Existing autoregressive in-context imitation methods discretize continuous actions and exacerbate the accumulation of early prediction errors through next-token prediction, limiting their generalization on unseen task configurations. Meanwhile, flow-matching policies have been explored for continuous robot control and can help mitigate compounding errors; however, in-context imitation learning within a flow-matching framework remains underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce ContextFlow, a conditional flow-matching model that learns continuous action distributions for in-context imitation learning. ContextFlow conditions flow-based action prediction on demonstrations and observations, enabling robust generation from noisy action distributions. To better encode multimodal in-context demonstrations, we adapt perceiver-style multimodal context compressors that distill visual, proprioceptive, and action sequences into compact, task-relevant latent representations. On LIBERO, ContextFlow outperforms ICRT by 35 percentage points in average success rate on unseen task configurations, while matching the performance of the task-specific fine-tuned VLA model $π_0$ without any fine-tuning on unseen tasks. On real robots, it generalizes to unseen configurations of both single-arm and bimanual tasks, achieving 40% success on a new pen-uncapping configuration. Project Page: https://dingjiansw101.github.io/contextflow-page/.

摘要（中文）：尽管上下文学习在视觉和语言领域已展现出高效性，但其在机器人领域的应用仍具挑战性。现有的自回归上下文模仿方法将连续动作离散化，并通过下一词元预测加剧早期预测误差的累积，从而限制了其在未见任务配置上的泛化能力。与此同时，流匹配策略已被探索用于连续机器人控制并有助于缓解复合误差问题，然而在流匹配框架内进行上下文模仿学习的研究仍尚不充分。为解决上述局限，我们提出了ContextFlow——一种面向上下文模仿学习的条件流匹配模型，该模型通过学习连续动作分布来驱动动作生成。ContextFlow将基于流的动作预测条件建立在示范数据与观测信息之上，从而能够从带噪声的动作分布中实现鲁棒生成。为更好地编码多模态上下文示范，我们采用了感知器风格的多模态上下文压缩器，将视觉、本体感知及动作序列蒸馏为紧凑的、与任务相关的潜在表征。在LIBERO基准上，ContextFlow在未见任务配置上的平均成功率较ICRT提升了35个百分点，同时在不经任何微调的情况下，其性能与针对特定任务微调过的VLA模型$π_0$持平。在真实机器人实验中，该方法能够泛化至单臂及双臂任务的未见配置，并在一种全新的开笔盖配置中实现了40%的成功率。项目页面：https://dingjiansw101.github.io/contextflow-page/。

Authors: Jian Ding, Xianjie Dai, Roei Herzig, Nussair Hroub, Jinjie Mai, Dengxin Dai, Bernard Ghanem, Mohamed Elhoseiny

Dex-X: Learning Visual-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation From Human Videos with Simulated Interaction Manipulation

visual-tactile dexterous manipulation human videos simulation sim-to-real transfer point-cloud observations

简要说明：Dex-X通过使用仿真来恢复触觉信息，从人类视频中学习视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略，实现了在真实灵巧手-臂平台上的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: Dex-X learns visual-tactile dexterous manipulation policies from human videos by using simulation to recover tactile information, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a real dexterous hand-arm platform.

Abstract: Human videos are an abundant source of dexterous manipulation behaviors, but they lack tactile information that is crucial for contact-rich interaction. This raises a fundamental question: can robots learn deployable visual-tactile dexterous manipulation policies from human video demonstrations without robot-side data collection? We present DEX-X, a framework for learning visual-tactile dexterous manipulation from human videos through simulation. Our key insight is that simulation can serve as a tactile completion engine. Given monocular human demonstrations, DEX-X reconstructs hand-object interactions in simulation, where physically grounded contact dynamics provide tactile supervision unavailable in the original videos. Leveraging this recovered tactile information, we train visual-tactile dexterous manipulation policies and distill them into deployable policies operating on point-cloud observations and tactile sensing. We demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a dexterous hand-arm platform across diverse grasping and contact-rich tool-use tasks. The teacher policy achieves 65.9% average success across six task categories in simulation, while the distilled visual-tactile policy achieves 93% success on real-world cube picking and 53% on the challenging table-cleaning task. Zero-shot generalization to unseen object geometries is also observed on object-picking tasks. Our results suggest that simulated interaction is a key bridge between human videos and deployable dexterous manipulation policies, providing the missing physical supervision needed for scalable robot skill learning from Internet-scale human video data.

摘要（中文）：人类视频是灵巧操作行为的丰富来源，但缺乏对接触密集交互至关重要的触觉信息。这引发了一个根本性问题：机器人能否在不进行机器人侧数据采集的情况下，从人类视频演示中学习可部署的视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略？ 我们提出DEX-X框架，通过仿真从人类视频中学习视觉-触觉灵巧操作。核心洞察在于，仿真可作为触觉补全引擎。给定单目人类演示，DEX-X在仿真中重建手-物交互过程，其中基于物理的接触动力学提供了原始视频中缺失的触觉监督信号。利用恢复的触觉信息，我们训练视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略，并将其蒸馏为可部署策略，该策略仅依赖点云观测与触觉传感。 我们在灵巧手-臂平台上实现了多种抓取与接触密集型工具操作任务的零样本仿真到现实迁移。教师策略在仿真中六个任务类别上平均成功率达65.9%，而蒸馏后的视觉-触觉策略在真实世界立方体抓取任务中达93%成功率，在具有挑战性的桌面清理任务中达53%。在物体抓取任务中还观察到了对未见物体几何形态的零样本泛化能力。 研究结果表明，仿真交互是连接人类视频与可部署灵巧操作策略的关键桥梁，为从互联网规模人类视频数据中实现可扩展的机器人技能学习提供了缺失的物理监督信号。

Authors: Ruoqu Chen, Feixiang Ruan, Liu Cao, Zihao Wang, Botian Xu, Shiqin Tong, Jiajun Liu, Mingzhi Pei, Chenyu Zhang, Wanli Xing, Kaifeng Zhang, Mengdi Xu

ICI-VLA: In-Context Imitation with Spatiotemporally Aligned Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

in-context imitation spatiotemporal alignment dynamic time warping target action masking robot manipulation

简要说明：ICI-VLA 提出了一种框架，使视觉-语言-动作模型能够通过上下文演示实现少样本测试时适应，无需梯度更新，通过检索时空对齐的微演示实现。

TLDR: ICI-VLA introduces a framework for vision-language-action models that enables few-shot test-time adaptation via in-context demonstrations, without gradient updates, by retrieving spatiotemporally aligned micro-demonstrations.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are commonly adapted to new manipulation settings through additional gradient updates, which limits rapid deployment when task-specific data or compute is scarce. We present ICI-VLA, a training and retrieval framework that equips a text-action VLM with few-shot test-time adaptation through in-context demonstrations. Unlike mainstream VLA designs based on action-specific multimodal fusion, ICI-VLA retains the native text-generation interface. ICI-VLA updates its parameters only during offline training; at inference, the policy remains fixed and conditions action generation on retrieved micro-demonstrations. The framework decomposes long trajectories into short, semantically labeled examples and trains an RD-Encoder with positives mined by Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), aligning the retrieved context with the phase and geometry of the current subtask. We further introduce Target Action Masking, a context-corruption objective designed to reduce direct action copying and increase reliance on the current observation. ICI-VLA reaches average success rates of 97.7% on LIBERO and 60.4% on RoboTwin 2.0, exceeding the highest reported baseline average on RoboTwin 2.0 by 19.3 percentage points. It also achieves 83.2% across four physical tasks. These results indicate that a fixed VLA policy can benefit from conditioning on spatiotemporally aligned demonstrations at test time.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常通过额外的梯度更新来适应新的操作场景，这在任务特定数据或计算资源稀缺时限制了快速部署。我们提出ICI-VLA，这是一种训练与检索框架，通过上下文演示为文本-动作VLM提供少样本测试时自适应能力。与基于动作特定多模态融合的主流VLA设计不同，ICI-VLA保留了原生的文本生成接口。ICI-VLA仅在离线训练期间更新参数；在推理时，策略保持固定，并根据检索到的微演示生成动作条件。该框架将长轨迹分解为带有语义标签的短示例，并通过动态时间规整（DTW）挖掘正样本来训练RD-编码器，使检索到的上下文与当前子任务的阶段和几何特征对齐。我们进一步引入目标动作遮蔽（Target Action Masking），这是一种上下文损坏目标，旨在减少直接动作复制并增强对当前观测的依赖。ICI-VLA在LIBERO上平均成功率达到97.7%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到60.4%，比RoboTwin 2.0上已报告的最高基线平均值高出19.3个百分点；同时在四项物理任务中达到83.2%的成功率。这些结果表明，固定VLA策略可在测试时通过基于时空对齐演示的条件生成中获益。

Authors: Songhua Yang, Ziyu Liu, Xuetao Li, Ruqi Xiao, Kangxin Zhu, Miao Li

Anti-Gravity Walking by a Flying Humanoid Robot via Thrust-Rate Input Whole-Body Model Predictive Control HumanoidEmbodied

flying humanoid whole-body MPC anti-gravity walking thrust-rate control contact force constraints

简要说明：提出一种基于推力率输入的实时全身MPC框架，实现飞天人形机器人在天花板等反重力环境中的双足行走，并引入接触力下界以增强稳定性，经过仿真和硬件实验验证。

TLDR: Proposes a real-time whole-body MPC framework using thrust-rate input for anti-gravity bipedal walking of a flying humanoid, with contact-force bounds for stability, demonstrated in simulation and hardware.

Abstract: Flying humanoids are expected to perform tasks in diverse environments, while their existing locomotion is mainly limited to aerial flight and ground walking. The capability to move in complex three-dimensional space can greatly expand their application range. For such walking motion on ceilings and similar anti-gravity environments, whole-body MPC is effective. However, the discontinuous changes in dynamic structure accompanying contact switching during walking can induce thrust spikes, resulting in control instability. Therefore, in this work, we propose and implement a real-time whole-body MPC framework for anti-gravity bipedal walking. First, we formulate whole-body MPC using the time derivative of thrust, namely thrust-rate, as the control input. This formulation guarantees continuity of the thrust trajectory during contact switching while preserving the sparse structure of the optimal control problem for fast computation. Second, we address the lack of natural support forces in anti-gravity environments. We introduce lower bounds on the foot-normal component of the contact force, and smoothly transfer them during the doublesupport phase. Finally, we implement the proposed framework and demonstrate anti-gravity walking by a flying humanoid through simulation and a hardware experiment. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of multi-contact whole-body MPC for a transformable aerial robot and walking by a flying humanoid beyond the ground.

摘要（中文）：飞行人形机器人在多样化环境中执行任务时，其现有运动能力主要局限于空中飞行和地面行走。若能在复杂三维空间中实现移动，将极大拓展其应用范围。针对天花板及类似反重力环境中的行走运动，全身模型预测控制（MPC）具有显著效果。然而，行走过程中接触切换引起的动力学结构不连续变化会导致推力尖峰，引发控制失稳。为此，本研究提出并实现了一种适用于反重力双足行走的实时全身MPC框架。首先，我们以推力时间导数（即推力变化率）为控制输入构建全身MPC模型。该公式在保证接触切换过程中推力轨迹连续性的同时，保留了最优控制问题的稀疏结构以支持快速计算。其次，我们针对反重力环境中自然支撑力缺失的问题，引入接触力足底法向分量的下限约束，并在双足支撑阶段实现该约束的平滑过渡。最终，通过仿真与硬件实验验证了所提框架，成功实现飞行人形机器人的反重力行走。据我们所知，这是首个针对可变形空中机器人的多接触全身MPC演示，也是飞行人形机器人在地面以外的行走突破。

Authors: Kazuki Sugihara, Kei Okada

Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Contact-Rich Assembly via Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Pretraining Manipulation

sim-to-real transfer proprioception-anchored cross-modal pretraining contact-rich assembly reinforcement learning

简要说明：PACE利用本体感受状态转换来监督跨模态视觉与力/力矩表示，实现了接触式装配的零样本仿真到现实迁移，在实际任务中成功率超过93%且鲁棒性强。

TLDR: PACE uses proprioceptive state transitions to supervise cross-modal visual and force/torque representations, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich assembly with high robustness and over 93% real-world success.

Abstract: Contact-rich assembly remains challenging because it requires submillimeter spatial accuracy and reliable interpretation of forces during sustained contact. Although simulation-based reinforcement learning offers a scalable training paradigm, discrepancies in visual observations, contact dynamics, and force/torque (F/T) measurements often limit policy transfer. We observe that proprioception is comparatively consistent across domains because calibrated joint positions and consistently computed joint velocities align closely between simulation and hardware. Based on this observation, we present PACE (Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Encoder), which supervises temporal visual and F/T representations by predicting proprioceptive state transitions. Static domain-specific factors, including lighting, texture, and sensor bias, contain little information about joint motion; the proposed objective therefore encourages the encoder to suppress these factors while retaining task-relevant motion cues. Policies trained on frozen PACE features are deployed on hardware without real-world fine-tuning or object-pose tracking. Across four contact-rich assembly tasks, PACE attains an average real-world success rate of 93.3\% and only a 2.7-percentage-point sim-to-real drop, meanwhile remaining robust to perturbations that substantially degrade pose-based and learned-fusion baselines.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的装配任务仍具挑战性，因其需在持续接触过程中实现亚毫米级空间精度及可靠的力感知解译。尽管基于仿真的强化学习提供了可扩展的训练范式，但视觉观测、接触动力学及力/力矩（F/T）测量之间的差异常限制策略迁移。我们观察到，由于标定后的关节位置与一致计算的关节速度在仿真与硬件间高度吻合，本体感知在不同域间具有相对一致性。基于此观察，我们提出PACE（本体感知锚定的跨模态编码器），通过预测本体状态迁移来监督时域视觉与F/T表征。静态域特定因素（包括光照、纹理及传感器偏差）包含的关节运动信息极少；所提目标函数因此促使编码器抑制这些因素，同时保留任务相关运动线索。基于冻结PACE特征训练的策略可直接部署于硬件，无需真实世界微调或物体位姿追踪。在四项接触丰富的装配任务中，PACE实现了93.3%的平均真实世界成功率，且仿真至现实的性能下降仅2.7个百分点，同时对于显著降低基于位姿及基于学习的融合基线的扰动具有稳健性。

Authors: Yuhan Wang, Yurou Chen, Hongye Jiang, Wenzhao Lian

Generation of Vectorized Maps Beyond Vehicle View AutonomousDriving

vectorized map generation beyond-view mapping online HD maps map forecasting autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了超视野矢量化地图生成这一自动驾驶新问题，并首次提出基于学习的BeyondFormer方法及专用数据集。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel problem of beyond-view vectorized map generation for autonomous driving, proposing BeyondFormer as the first learning-based approach, along with a dedicated dataset.

Abstract: Autonomous driving relies on High Definition (HD) maps for safe navigation. Traditional HD maps construction is costly in hardware, data and human resources, which together with its update limitations hinders scalability. Recent works have proposed online alternatives for HD vectorized mapping from onboard sensors. However, sensor field of view is limited, and the range of the reconstructed maps ahead of the vehicle is insufficient for safe planning. This paper aims to address this limitation by proposing the novel beyond-view vectorized map generation problem: given vectorized maps of the area sensed by the vehicle (in-view), to generate plausible map continuations. To experimentally assess its feasibility, we propose BeyondFormer, which, to the best of out knowledge, is the first work designed towards beyond-view map generation. Given the novelty of the problem, we generate the first dataset specifically designed for it and evaluate the proposed approach. The results demonstrate consistent performance across diverse scenarios, establishing learning-based methods as a promising direction for map forecasting in autonomous driving. Beyond demonstrating the feasibility of the task, we provide an extensive discussion of the method's limitations and identify key future research directions for scaling it to more complex driving conditions. Code is available at https://git-autopia.car.upm-csic.es/beyondformer.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶依赖于高清（HD）地图实现安全导航。传统高清地图的构建在硬件、数据及人力资源方面成本高昂，同时其更新能力的局限性阻碍了可扩展性。近期研究提出了基于车载传感器进行在线高清矢量地图构建的替代方案。然而，传感器的视野有限，在车辆前方重建出的地图范围不足以支持安全规划。本文旨在解决这一局限，提出新颖的超视距矢量地图生成问题：给定车辆感知区域内（视场内）的矢量地图，生成合理的地图延续部分。为实验评估其可行性，我们提出了BeyondFormer——据我们所知，这是首个针对超视距地图生成的研究工作。鉴于该问题的新颖性，我们构建了首个专为此设计的专用数据集，并对所提方法进行了评估。结果表明该方法在不同场景下均表现出一致性能，确立了基于学习的方法作为自动驾驶地图预测领域的一个有前景方向。除验证任务可行性外，我们还深入讨论了方法的局限性，并指出了将其扩展到更复杂驾驶条件的关键未来研究方向。代码详见 https://git-autopia.car.upm-csic.es/beyondformer。

Authors: Clara Gomez, Alberto Jaenal, Antonio Artuñedo, Jorge Godoy, Jorge Villagra

Measuring Language Transfer in Robot Policies: Adding Greek to a Cosmos3 Vision-Language-Action Policy VLA

low-resource language robot policy localization multilingual VLA measurement pitfalls bilingual training

简要说明：本文系统研究了仅通过机器改写指令将希腊语添加到Cosmos3视觉-语言-动作策略中的方法，揭示了评估低资源语言机器人策略的陷阱，并发现双语训练能持续提升性能，且无需希腊语演示数据。

TLDR: This paper systematically studies the addition of Greek to a Cosmos3 VLA policy using only machine-rephrased instructions, identifying pitfalls in evaluating low-resource-language robot policies and finding that bilingual training yields consistent gains without requiring Greek demonstrations.

Abstract: Robot foundation models are trained and evaluated predominantly in English, and robot demonstration corpora do not exist for most languages. We study the addition of Greek to an open vision-language-action stack using only machine-rephrased instructions and no architecture changes. The main challenge is measurement rather than translation. Several plausible instruments produce false conclusions: a color-histogram metric rewards noise, a single-goal benchmark scores 84.6% under correct Greek and 82.6% under deliberately wrong instructions, training loss fails to predict Greek success, and single-run comparisons are dominated by seed variation. On a discriminative ninety-task suite with three seeds per arm, a multilingual text tower without Greek demonstrations remains at its wrong-instruction floor, while Greek-only training exceeds its control by at most 2.7 points. Bilingual training yields a consistent 6.7-7.1 point margin over its control and reaches about two fifths of English performance. The policy also overfits the translator's phrasing; training on seven phrasings per task approximately halves this penalty. Warm-starting from a language-adapted world model and unfreezing the text tower both degrade performance. The results support two practical requirements for low-resource robot-policy localization: build a guaranteed null before trusting a metric, and replicate low-resource-language results across seeds.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型的训练与评估主要基于英语，而大多数语言并不存在机器人演示语料库。我们研究仅使用机器改写指令且不改变架构的情况下，将希腊语引入开放视觉-语言-动作栈。主要挑战在于评估而非翻译。多种看似合理的工具会得出错误结论：颜色直方图指标会奖励噪声，单目标基准在正确希腊语指令下得分为84.6%，在故意错误指令下为82.2%，训练损失无法预测希腊语成功率，而单次运行比较结果受随机种子影响显著。在包含三个随机种子、每机械臂90项任务的判别式测试集中，未使用希腊语演示的多语言文本塔保持错误指令基线水平，而仅用希腊语训练的模型比对照组最多高出2.7个分数点。双语训练相比对照组获得持续6.7-7.1个分数点的优势，并达到英语性能的五分之二左右。该策略还会过拟合译者的措辞风格；每项任务使用七种措辞训练可将此惩罚降低约一半。从语言适配的世界模型进行热启动以及解冻文本塔都会降低性能。上述结果支持低资源机器人策略本地化的两项实践要求：在信任某个指标前先建立保证性零基线，以及跨随机种子复制低资源语言实验结果。

Authors: Ayoub Kirouane, Georgios Giaples, Christos Petrocheilos

PV-WM: A Heterogeneous Micro-Macro World Model for Articulated Pedestrian-Vehicle Co-Rollout AutonomousDriving

world model pedestrian-vehicle forecasting articulated motion heterogeneous state recurrent rollout

简要说明：本文提出了PV-WM，一个能够联合预测行人姿态和车辆运动的世界模型，用于异构交通参与者的未来状态预测，在降低计算成本的同时取得了最先进的预测精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces PV-WM, a world model that jointly predicts pedestrian articulation and vehicle motion for heterogeneous traffic agents, achieving state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy with lower computational cost.

Abstract: Local pedestrian-vehicle forecasting spans heterogeneous physical scales: pedestrians combine root locomotion with articulated motion, whereas vehicles are rigid bodies described by kinematic state and oriented extent. Existing road-agent forecasters typically omit pedestrian articulation, while pose forecasters leave vehicle futures outside the learned rollout. We introduce PV-WM, a history-only world model over structured post-perception tracks. It recurrently advances pedestrian root motion, 15-joint articulation, and learned vehicle states within a synchronized heterogeneous state. The generated pedestrian and vehicle chunks supply the next recurrent boundary; vehicle boxes are reconstructed from predicted center and heading with observed extent, and P-V geometry is recomputed after every transition. Relative to a matched one-shot complete-state predictor, recurrent execution reduces Root ADE by 12.7% and MPJPE by 14.8%. Feedback interventions show that later predictions depend on the content, temporal order, and pedestrian identity of generated articulation. Across 824 aligned Waymo contexts, with 797 providing valid future vehicle support, PV-WM reduces Root ADE by 5.2%, MPJPE by 7.6%, P-V distance error by 11.9%, and oriented-box closest-approach error by 5.8% relative to a validation-selected Modular Specialist. The single-network model uses 57.1% fewer parameters, 96.5% lower average FLOPs per local scene, and 25.5% lower measured p95 latency. PV-WM unifies this heterogeneous future state while preserving type-specific pedestrian and vehicle dynamics.

摘要（中文）：局部行人-车辆预测跨越异质性物理尺度：行人结合根部运动与关节运动，而车辆则是由运动学状态和朝向范围描述的刚体。现有道路智能体预测器通常忽略行人关节结构，而姿态预测器则将车辆未来状态排除在学习推演之外。我们提出PV-WM，一种基于结构化后感知轨迹的纯历史世界模型。该模型在同步异质性状态中递归推进行人根部运动、15关节运动学及学习到的车辆状态。生成的行人与车辆数据块服务于下一递归边界；车辆包围盒由预测中心点与朝向结合观测尺寸重建，每次状态转换后重新计算行人-车辆几何关系。相较于匹配的单一时刻全状态预测器，递归执行将根部平均位移误差降低12.7%，平均关节位置误差降低14.8%。反馈干预实验表明，后续预测依赖于生成关节内容、时序顺序及行人身份。在824个对齐的Waymo场景中（其中797个提供有效未来车辆支撑），相较于验证集选定的模块化专家模型，PV-WM将根部ADE降低5.2%，MPJPE降低7.6%，行人-车辆距离误差降低11.9%，朝向包围盒最近接近误差降低5.8%。该单网络模型参数量减少57.1%，每局部场景平均FLOPs降低96.5%，实测p95延迟降低25.5%。PV-WM在统一异质性未来状态的同时，保留了类型特定的行人与车辆动力学特征。

Authors: Haozhuang Chi, Jingsong Liang, Ziying Song, Lei Yang, Shihao Li, Haoruo Zhang, Chen Lv

How Long Until Your Robot Ignores You? A Safety Benchmark for LLM Orchestrators in Human-Humanoid Collaboration HumanoidEmbodied

LLM orchestrator safety benchmark human-humanoid collaboration compliance taxonomy ISO 10218-2:2025

简要说明：该论文首次提出了用于人形机器人协作中基于LLM的编排器的安全基准，定义了安全不变量、合规性分类法和多层评估管道。在四个LLM后端上的第一层结果显示，模型系列和上下文管理对安全违规有关键影响。

TLDR: This paper introduces the first safety benchmark for LLM-based orchestrators in human-humanoid collaboration, defining safety invariants, a compliance taxonomy, and a multi-layer evaluation pipeline. Layer-1 results on four LLM backends reveal that model family and context management critically affect safety violations.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed to orchestrate robot behavior through natural-language interfaces, yet no benchmark exists to evaluate their reliability as safety-aware decision makers in human-humanoid collaboration. Unlike deterministic safety systems that enforce binary allow/deny decisions, LLM-based orchestrators exhibit a compliance spectrum ranging from overcompliance (refusing safe actions) to full safety violations. This paper introduces the first safety benchmarking environment for LLM orchestrators in human-humanoid collaboration, built on a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based architecture with safety invariants grounded in ISO 10218-2:2025 protective measures. The benchmark defines five testable safety invariants, a four-level compliance taxonomy (correct compliance, overcompliance, undercompliance, full violation), and a three-layer evaluation pipeline (text prompting, simulated sensor-actuator loops, and physical validation on a Unitree G1 EDU humanoid). We report Layer-1 results: three cloud backends (Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash) and a local open-weights baseline (qwen3:8b) across 40 100-turn sessions under full-context and sliding-window budget conditions, while the simulation and physical layers remain ongoing. We find that (1) model family determines the safety floor, as Claude and Gemini remain at or near zero violations while GPT-4o-mini commits up to 13 per session, (2) context management dissociates two failure axes, reducing mean behavioral issues by 42-57% for every cloud backend while nearly doubling GPT-4o-mini's violations (3.8 to 7.2 per session), and (3) proportional compliance, clamping movement speed to the rule-specified maximum rather than refusing, emerges consistently only in Gemini; the preliminary simulation layer reproduces the model ranking and the GPT-4o-mini failure-mode inversion.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于通过自然语言接口编排机器人行为，但目前尚无基准测试来评估其在人形机器人协作中作为具有安全意识决策者的可靠性。与强制执行二元允许/拒绝决策的确定性安全系统不同，基于LLM的编排器表现出从过度合规（拒绝安全行为）到完全违反安全规定的合规谱系。本文介绍了首个用于人形机器人协作中LLM编排器的安全基准测试环境，该环境基于模型上下文协议（MCP）架构构建，其安全不变量根植于ISO 10218-2:2025防护措施。该基准定义了五个可测试的安全不变量、一个四级合规分类体系（正确合规、过度合规、不足合规、完全违规）以及一个三层评估流水线（文本提示、模拟传感器-执行器循环，以及在宇树G1 EDU人形机器人上进行的物理验证）。我们报告了第一层结果：三个云后端（Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash）和一个本地开源权重基线（qwen3:8b）在全上下文和滑动窗口预算条件下进行了40轮100回合的测试，而模拟层与物理层仍在进行中。我们发现：(1) 模型家族决定了安全底线，Claude和Gemini保持零违规或接近零违规，而GPT-4o-mini每轮违规次数高达13次；(2) 上下文管理将两种失效轴分离，使每个云后端的平均行为问题减少42-57%，但同时使GPT-4o-mini的违规次数几乎翻倍（从每轮3.8次增至7.2次）；(3) 比例合规（将运动速度限制在规则规定的最大值而非直接拒绝）仅在Gemini中一致出现；初步模拟层复现了模型排名及GPT-4o-mini失效模式的逆转现象。

Authors: Aulon Bajrami, Mohamed Elshamouty, Werner Kraus

EquiGQNet: Fast Grasp Quality Evaluation via Shared Equivariant Point Cloud Encoding Manipulation

grasp quality evaluation equivariant point cloud encoding 6-DoF grasping mid-level action fusion

简要说明：EquiGQNet通过SO(3)等变的一次编码再旋转方案和中间层动作融合，实现了快速准确的6自由度抓取质量评估，在仿真和真实世界物品整理任务中均优于早期融合和晚期融合基线。

TLDR: EquiGQNet uses an SO(3)-equivariant encode-once-then-rotate scheme and mid-level action fusion to achieve fast and accurate 6-DoF grasp quality evaluation, outperforming early- and late-fusion baselines in both simulation and real-world decluttering tasks.

Abstract: Planning six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) grasps for unseen objects in cluttered tabletop scenes from a single-view depth image requires accurate and efficient evaluation of diverse grasp candidates. Existing early-fusion methods capture local object geometry relative to each grasp candidate but repeatedly encode the scene, whereas late-fusion methods reuse a shared scene representation but may lose this grasp-relative local geometry. We propose EquiGQNet, an efficient 6-DoF grasp quality evaluator that combines the strengths of both approaches. For grasp orientation, EquiGQNet replaces the early-fusion operation of rotating and re-encoding the point cloud for each grasp candidate with an SO(3)-equivariant encode-once-then-rotate scheme, yielding grasp-aligned geometric features from a shared scene encoding. For grasp translation, Mid-level Action Fusion (MAF) injects the grasp position into intermediate features before global aggregation, retaining local geometry relative to each candidate. We evaluate EquiGQNet in two grasp planning pipelines: Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based continuous grasp search and candidate ranking with a pretrained generative planner. In simulation, EquiGQNet achieves grasping performance comparable to the early-fusion baseline and substantially outperforms late fusion on objects with complex geometry and limited graspable regions, while reducing CEM planning time from 3.31s to 0.48s, a 6.9x speedup over early fusion. In real-world household-object decluttering, EquiGQNet achieves a 95.2% grasp success rate and 230 picks per hour, versus 153 and 170 for early- and late-fusion baselines. Code is available at https://equigqnet.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：针对单视角深度图像中未见物体在杂乱桌面场景下的六自由度抓取规划，需要准确高效地评估多种抓取候选方案。现有早期融合方法虽能捕获每个候选抓取相对于局部物体几何特征，但需重复编码场景；而晚期融合方法可复用共享场景表征，却可能丢失与抓取关联的局部几何信息。本文提出EquiGQNet——一种结合两类方法优势的高效六自由度抓取质量评估器。在抓取方向处理上，EquiGQNet采用SO(3)等变"一次编码再旋转"方案替代传统早期融合中为每个候选抓取旋转并重新编码点云的操作，从而从共享场景编码中提取与抓取对齐的几何特征。在抓取平移处理上，通过中层动作融合（MAF）在全局聚合前将抓取位置注入中间特征，保留每个候选抓取相关的局部几何信息。我们在两种抓取规划流水线中评估EquiGQNet：基于交叉熵方法（CEM）的连续抓取搜索，以及使用预训练生成规划器的候选排序。仿真实验中，EquiGQNet实现了与早期融合基线相当的抓取性能，在几何复杂且可抓取区域有限的物体上大幅超越晚期融合方法，同时将CEM规划时间从3.31秒降至0.48秒，相比早期融合加速6.9倍。在真实家庭场景物品整理中，EquiGQNet达到95.2%的抓取成功率与每小时230次抓取，而早期和晚期融合基线分别为153次和170次。代码已发布于https://equigqnet.github.io/。

Authors: Sungwon Seo, Jaeseog Won, Jiyou Shin, Youngjin Seo, Hyunjun Kim, Seokmin Yoon, Tuan Luong, Hyungpil Moon

Beyond Task Success: Stage-Wise Reliability of World Model Planning under Sensing Degradation WorldModel

world model planning sensing degradation stage-wise reliability planning disturbances manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种针对感知退化下世界模型规划的分阶段可靠性分析，揭示扰动在表征、预测和规划阶段非均匀传播，有助于优先进行缓解。

TLDR: This paper proposes a stage-wise reliability analysis for world model planning under sensing degradation, revealing that disturbances propagate non-uniformly across representation, prediction, and planning stages, which helps prioritize mitigation.

Abstract: In world model planning, sensing inputs pass through an encoder and predictor before affecting planner decisions, so final task success alone cannot reveal where sensing disturbances attenuate or persist in the pipeline. We apply 10 visual and temporal sensing degradations to a world model planner and track their effects across representation, future prediction, planner preference, and physical outcome using paired evaluation on the same 50 tasks. The relative impact of degradations was not preserved across stages: large representation shifts could attenuate downstream, while smaller initial shifts could persist to the outcome, and internal-response ordering did not directly match physical-outcome ordering. Temporal degradations also showed distinct patterns: even with similar overall changes in observation history, responses differed substantially with the location of corrupted information and the planner's actual exposure. This non-uniform stage-wise response was also observed in secondary evaluations with another manipulation task and a different world model. Stage-wise diagnosis can therefore identify where sensing disturbances attenuate or persist and help prioritize subsequent model verification and sensing mitigation.

摘要（中文）：在世界模型规划中，感知输入在影响规划器决策之前需先经过编码器和预测器，因此仅凭最终任务成功与否无法揭示感知干扰在流程中哪些环节被削弱或持续存在。我们对一个世界模型规划器施加10种视觉与时间感知退化，并通过在相同的50项任务上进行配对评估，追踪了这些退化在表征、未来预测、规划器偏好及物理结果上的影响。退化在各阶段的相对影响并不一致：较大的表征偏移可能在下游被削弱，而较小的初始偏移可能持续至最终结果，且内部响应排序与物理结果排序并不直接对应。时间退化也呈现出独特模式：即使观测历史的整体变化相似，受污染信息的位置及规划器的实际暴露程度不同，响应也会产生显著差异。在另一项操控任务及不同世界模型的二次评估中，同样观察到了这种非均匀的阶段响应。因此，分阶段诊断可识别感知干扰被削弱或持续存在的环节，有助于优先安排后续模型验证与感知缓解措施。

Authors: Geonmyeong Lee, Byoung-Tak Zhang

From LLM-Generated Specifications to Learned Quadruped Locomotion Locomotion

quadruped locomotion LLM-generated specifications signal temporal logic PPO reward design

简要说明：本文利用大型语言模型从自然语言生成PSTL规范，并将其转化为奖励函数，通过PPO训练四足机器人运动策略。

TLDR: This paper uses LLMs to generate PSTL specifications from natural language, which are then transformed into reward functions for training quadruped locomotion policies via PPO.

Abstract: Quadruped robot locomotion policies are often trained using reinforcement learning, which in turn relies heavily on hand-crafted reward functions. Designing reward functions requires substantial manual engineering, and it is often unclear which local rewards will induce the desired global behavior. Shaped rewards from formal specifications in languages like Signal Temporal Logic (STL) can make rewards more interpretable, but writing STL specifications itself still requires domain expertise. We study whether large language models (LLMs) can fill this gap by generating Parametric Signal Temporal Logic (PSTL) specifications that are subsequently used for policy learning. Given a natural language locomotion objective and a constrained specification grammar, GPT-5.5 and Qwen 3.6 independently propose STL templates for command tracking, safety, and gait structure. We instantiate the parameters of the generated PSTL templates using expert trajectories and retain only specifications that are consistent with demonstrated expert behavior. The resulting specifications are then transformed into smooth, finite-history reward functions and used to train a quadruped locomotion policy with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in MuJoCo XLA (MJX). We evaluate both \emph{gait-aware} and \emph{gait-agnostic} settings. The former specifies walking-trot, trot, and bound regimes, while the latter allows contact patterns to emerge from the task objective. We compare against hand-engineered rewards, Text2Reward-style LLM-generated reward code, and an expert-switching oracle. Gait-aware Qwen 3.6 specifications achieved 100\% survival and command success across all tested speeds (0.3--2.1 m/s) and matched the target gait at high speeds, whereas Text2Reward achieved 0\% for both metrics at $\geq 1.9$ m/s. Videos: https://stl-locomotion.github.io/

摘要（中文）：四足机器人运动策略通常通过强化学习训练，而这又高度依赖手动设计的奖励函数。设计奖励函数需要大量人工工程，且往往难以确定哪些局部奖励能诱导出期望的全局行为。基于信号时序逻辑（STL）等语言的形式化规范所构建的塑形奖励，虽能提高奖励的可解释性，但编写STL规范本身仍需要领域专业知识。本文研究大语言模型（LLM）能否通过生成参数化信号时序逻辑（PSTL）规范来填补这一空白，并将这些规范用于策略学习。给定自然语言描述的运动目标及受限的规范语法，GPT-5.5与Qwen 3.6可独立为指令跟踪、安全性和步态结构提出STL模板。我们利用专家轨迹实例化所生成PSTL模板的参数，仅保留与演示专家行为一致的规范。随后将这些规范转换为平滑的有限历史奖励函数，并在MuJoCo XLA（MJX）中采用近端策略优化（PPO）训练四足机器人运动策略。我们分别评估了\emph{步态感知}与\emph{步态无关}两种设置：前者指定行走-快步、快步及跳跃步态模式，后者允许接触模式从任务目标中自然涌现。我们将所提方法与手工设计的奖励、Text2Reward风格LLM生成的奖励代码以及专家切换“神谕”进行对比。步态感知的Qwen 3.6规范在所有测试速度（0.3–2.1 m/s）下均实现100%的生存率与指令成功率，并在高速阶段匹配目标步态；而Text2Reward在速度≥1.9 m/s时两项指标均为0%。视频链接：https://stl-locomotion.github.io/

Authors: Merve Atasever, Keyan Azbijari, Cagan Bakirci, Alfredo Reina Corona, Tolga Izdas, Richard Yang, Erdem Biyik, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh

RoboDreamer: Anticipatory Humanoid Locomotion with Predictive State-Space Models HumanoidEmbodied

teacher-student framework next-observation consistency randomized temporal masking Mamba backbone humanoid locomotion

简要说明：RoboDreamer 提出了一种教师-学生框架，通过下一个观测一致性和随机时间掩码实现人形机器人运动控制，利用 Mamba 作为时间骨干网络，在观测噪声下实现鲁棒的轨迹跟踪并成功部署到真实机器人。

TLDR: RoboDreamer introduces a teacher-student framework with next-observation consistency and randomized temporal masking for humanoid locomotion, using Mamba as a temporal backbone to enable robust tracking under observation noise and real-world deployment.

Abstract: Humanoid locomotion requires control policies that remain stable under imperfect sensing while exploiting temporal context for consistent motion. We present RoboDreamer, a two-stage teacher--student framework that combines next-observation consistency with randomized continuous temporal masking. A teacher is first trained on clean observations, and a student is then distilled under masked recent observations, encouraging the policy to infer missing current information from history. At inference, the same masking interface is reused for implicit closed-loop action refinement and optional multi-step action chunking. Mamba is used as the temporal backbone, while matched ablations show that masking/distillation provides a substantial part of the gain and Mamba contributes additional tracking improvements with real-time latency. Experiments in IsaacLab, MuJoCo, and on a Unitree G1 demonstrate robust motion tracking under observation masking and successful real-world deployment.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人运动控制需要具备在感知不完美条件下保持稳定的控制策略，同时利用时间上下文信息实现一致的运动。我们提出RoboDreamer——一种两阶段师生框架，将下一观测一致性与随机连续时间掩码相结合。首先在清晰观测数据上训练教师网络，随后学生网络在掩码化近期观测数据上进行蒸馏，促使策略从历史信息中推断缺失的当前状态。推理阶段复用相同的掩码接口，实现隐式闭环动作精化与可选的多步动作分块。采用Mamba作为时序主干网络，匹配消融实验表明掩码/蒸馏机制贡献了主要性能增益，而Mamba在实时延迟条件下进一步改善了跟踪效果。在IsaacLab、MuJoCo模拟环境及宇树G1机器人上的实验证明，该方法在观测掩码条件下仍能实现稳健的运动跟踪，并成功完成真实场景部署。

Authors: Zhe Li, Yangyang Wei, Xichen Yuan, Zhenzhe Zhang, Weihao Yuan, Shanghang Zhang, Jianfei Yang

Large Discrete Policy: Advancing Explicit Behavior Modeling with Stochastic Iterative Scoring VLA

discrete policy stochastic iterative scoring behavior modeling autonomous driving robotic manipulation

简要说明：该论文提出了大规模离散策略（LDiP），一个全离散行为建模框架，通过随机迭代评分在合理动作候选词中进行选择和剪枝，在自动驾驶和机器人操作中超越了连续和离散基线方法。

TLDR: The paper introduces Large Discrete Policy (LDiP), a fully discrete behavior modeling framework that uses stochastic iterative scoring over a vocabulary of plausible action candidates, outperforming continuous and discrete baselines in autonomous driving and robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Behavior policies are often formulated as continuous generative models, whose iterative denoising processes are expressive but difficult to interpret and prone to producing implausible actions. We propose the Large Discrete Policy (LDiP), a fully discrete behavior modeling framework that selects actions from a large vocabulary of physically plausible candidates. Rather than perturbing actions, LDiP improves expressivity through stochastic iterative scoring: it progressively re-scores and prunes candidates with score-space stochasticity, enabling fine-grained ranking and exploration among plausible actions while preserving an explicit decision process. Across end-to-end planning, closed-loop driving, robotic manipulation, and vision-language-action settings, LDiP consistently outperforms strong discrete and continuous baselines in autonomous driving, and exceeds or matches continuous generative policies in robotic manipulation. These results show that discrete policies, when equipped with effective scoring mechanisms, offer an expressive, plausible, and interpretable alternative for behavior modeling. Project website: https://zhenxinli.net/LargeDiscretePolicy/.

摘要（中文）：行为策略通常被建模为连续生成模型，其迭代去噪过程虽具表现力但难以解释，且容易产生不可信的动作为。我们提出大规模离散策略（LDiP），这是一种全离散行为建模框架，能够从包含大量物理合理候选动作的词汇表中进行选择。与扰动动作不同，LDiP通过随机迭代评分来提升表现力：它逐步对候选动作进行重新评分并剪枝，在评分空间中引入随机性，从而在可信动作之间实现细粒度的排序与探索，同时保持显式的决策过程。在端到端规划、闭环驾驶、机器人操作以及视觉-语言-动作场景中，LDiP在自动驾驶任务上持续优于强大的离散与连续基线方法，在机器人操作任务上则超越或持平于连续生成策略。实验结果表明，当配备有效的评分机制时，离散策略能够为行为建模提供一种兼具表现力、可信度与可解释性的替代方案。项目网站：https://zhenxinli.net/LargeDiscretePolicy/。

Authors: Zhenxin Li, Nadine Chang, Xinglong Sun, Jingde Chen, Wenhao Yao, Zi Wang, Maying Shen, Yu-Gang Jiang, Zuxuan Wu, Shiyi Lan, Jose M. Alvarez

MEMOBench: A Process Level Memory Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

memory benchmark robotic manipulation VLA policies process-level evaluation memory augmentation

简要说明：MEMOBench 是一个用于评估机器人操作策略中记忆操作（存储、更新、压缩）的基准，提供超越任务成功的过程级指标。

TLDR: MEMOBench is a benchmark for evaluating memory operations (storage, update, compression) in robotic manipulation policies, providing process-level metrics beyond task success.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires acting on information that is no longer visible, yet Vision-Language-Action policies are usually evaluated when the current observation largely determines the next action. Existing robotic memory benchmarks expose this gap, but they still rely mainly on final task success and therefore conflate forgetting with manipulation failure. We present \textbf{MEMOBench}, a benchmark for process level memory evaluation in robotic manipulation. MEMOBench includes 30 history dependent tasks, 1{,}500 expert demonstrations, and 4{,}200 executable checkpoint instances from 84 templates. Each checkpoint pairs coarse to fine language with a simulator predicate and labels one memory operation: Storage, Update, or Compression. These annotations define Memory Storage Rate, Memory Update Rate, and Memory Compression Rate, which measure memory fidelity alongside task success. Across standard and memory augmented VLA policies, the strongest memory module baseline reaches only 31.9\% average success rate, and high storage often coexists with weak update and compression. Checkpoint language also supervises semantic, contrastive, and framewise memory alignment objectives, yielding modest gains across different memory operations. MEMOBench provides a diagnostic evaluation suite and training supervision for memory grounded robotic policies. The project page is available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/MEMOBench.

摘要（中文）：**摘要：** 机器人操作常常需要基于已不可见的视觉信息进行决策，然而当前视觉-语言-动作策略的评估大多依赖于当前观测能否主导下一步动作。现有的机器人记忆基准测试虽揭示了这一差距，但仍主要依据最终任务成功率来评判，因而将遗忘与操作失败混为一谈。本文提出**MEMOBench**——一个用于机器人操作过程级记忆评估的基准。MEMOBench包含30个依赖历史信息的任务、1500次专家演示，以及来自84个模板的4200个可执行检查点实例。每个检查点将粗细粒度语言与模拟器谓词配对，并标注一种记忆操作：存储、更新或压缩。这些标注定义了记忆存储率、记忆更新率和记忆压缩率，用以在任务成功率之外衡量记忆保真度。在标准策略与记忆增强型VLA策略的对比中，最强记忆模块基线的平均成功率仅为31.9%，且高存储率常与低更新率及低压缩率并存。检查点语言还可监督语义级、对比级与帧级记忆对齐目标，在不同记忆操作上获得适度提升。MEMOBench为基于记忆的机器人策略提供了诊断评估套件与训练监督。项目页面见 https://github.com/Collab-Gen/MEMOBench。

Authors: Haiyang Sun, Haoxiao Wang, Junming Chen, Weicheng Fang, Zihao Su, Jingkun Yi, Wenyou Yi, Hao Chen, Zhou Zhao

WM-Craftnet: World Synesthesia Model for Generalizable and Robust Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Manipulation

dexterous in-hand manipulation world model multi-modal reconstruction tactile sensing sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：提出了WM-Craftnet，一种世界模型条件下的灵巧手内操作框架，利用世界联觉模型（WSM）提供去噪几何状态和触觉上下文，提高了跨物体和干扰下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

TLDR: Proposes WM-Craftnet, a world model conditioned framework for dexterous in-hand manipulation that leverages a World Synesthesia Model (WSM) to provide denoised geometric state and tactile context, improving robustness and generalization across objects and disturbances.

Abstract: Generalizable and robust dexterous in-hand manipulation requires a policy to infer object pose, geometry, contact, and potential slip from partial and noisy observations. Although recent tactile and visuotactile RL methods achieve strong in-hand rotation in controlled settings, their robustness often degrades under pose shifts, force disturbances, and object variation. We propose WM-Craftnet, a world-model-conditioned framework that learns compact action-conditioned latent dynamics from proprioception, depth, tactile sensing, and actions, supervised by multimodal reconstruction and reward prediction. Rather than using the world model for latent imagination or policy optimization, WM-Craftnet uses the learned World Synesthesia Model (WSM) as recurrent task context for an asymmetric actor--critic policy. Importantly, WSM is trained to reconstruct clean depth targets from noisy depth inputs, providing a denoised geometric state for real-robot deployment. Ablations over recurrent baselines, auxiliary heads, tactile masking, and WSM modality heads show that predictive world modeling, clean-depth supervision, and tactile contact cues all shape the learned state. A WSM pretrained on nine \(z\)-axis objects serves as a reusable prior for \(49\)-object downstream policy learning. This context improves multi-object rotation, with quantitative and qualitative evidence for unseen-object, perturbation-recovery, and sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：通用且鲁棒的灵巧手内操作要求策略能够从局部且有噪声的观测中推断物体位姿、几何形状、接触状态及潜在滑移。尽管近期基于触觉和视觉-触觉的强化学习方法在受控环境下实现了强劲的手内旋转能力，但其鲁棒性在位姿偏移、力干扰及物体变化条件下往往显著下降。我们提出WM-Craftnet——一种基于世界模型的条件框架，该框架从本体感知、深度信息、触觉感知及动作中学习紧凑的动作条件化隐变量动力学，并通过多模态重建与奖励预测进行监督。WM-Craftnet并非将世界模型用于隐式想象或策略优化，而是将学得的“世界联觉模型”（WSM）作为非对称演员-评论家策略的循环任务上下文。关键之处在于，WSM被训练为从含噪深度输入中重建清洁深度目标，从而为真实机器人部署提供去噪后的几何状态。针对循环基线、辅助头、触觉掩码及WSM模态头的消融实验表明：预测性世界建模、清洁深度监督及触觉接触线索共同塑造了学得的状态。在九个z轴物体上预训练的WSM可作为49个物体下游策略学习的可复用先验。该上下文提升了多物体旋转性能，并通过未见物体、扰动恢复及仿真到现实迁移的定量与定性证据得到验证。

Authors: Jie Yin, Zeyuan Zhao, Xiaojing Tan, Yang Liu, Chiyu Wang, Xinyang Gu

DriftParking: Trajectory Modeling via Drifting Field for End-to-End Automated Parking AutonomousDriving

end-to-end automated parking trajectory generation drifting field one-step generation endpoint alignment

简要说明：DriftParking 提出了一种用于端到端自动泊车的一步式轨迹生成框架，利用漂移场动力学（包括一对一吸引、专家中心排斥和端点残差分解），实现了最先进的性能和 97% 的闭环泊车成功率。

TLDR: DriftParking proposes a one-step trajectory generation framework for end-to-end automated parking that uses drifting-field dynamics with one-to-one attraction, expert-centered repulsion, and endpoint-residual decomposition to achieve state-of-the-art performance and 97% closed-loop parking success.

Abstract: Automated parking requires generating complete and executable trajectories in highly constrained spaces with low tolerance for goal pose error. Existing end-to-end parking methods struggle to jointly achieve inference efficiency, trajectory quality, and precise endpoint alignment, while conventional imitation objectives provide limited supervision on structured deviations from expert maneuver geometry. We propose DriftParking, a one-step trajectory generation framework that reconstructs the drifting-field paradigm for high-precision conditional trajectory generation. Specifically, we replace distribution-level attraction with conditional one-to-one attraction toward the paired expert trajectory, introduce expert-centered constructive repulsion, and adaptively attenuate repulsion near convergence. We further formulate trajectory generation in an endpoint-residual space by decomposing each trajectory into a start-to-goal baseline and a learnable residual, turning endpoint alignment into a representation-level structural constraint on the supervision target while providing a structured space for repulsive supervision. DriftParking achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation metrics. Closed-loop on-vehicle experiments across diverse parking scenarios further show a 97% parking success rate, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization.

摘要（中文）：自动泊车需要在高度受限的空间中生成完整且可执行的轨迹，并对目标位姿误差具有低容忍度。现有端到端泊车方法难以同时兼顾推理效率、轨迹质量与精确终点对齐，而传统模仿目标对专家操作几何结构的结构化偏差提供的监督有限。我们提出DriftParking——一种一步式轨迹生成框架，通过重构漂移场范式实现高精度条件式轨迹生成。具体而言，我们将分布级吸引替换为面向配对专家轨迹的条件式一对一吸引，引入以专家为中心的结构化排斥，并在收敛附近自适应衰减排斥作用。通过将每条轨迹分解为起始至目标的基线与可学习残差，我们进一步在终点残差空间中构建轨迹生成，将终点对齐转化为监督目标上的表征级结构约束，同时为排斥监督提供结构化空间。DriftParking在所有评估指标上均达到最先进性能。跨多种泊车场景的闭环实车实验进一步展示了97%的泊车成功率，证实其强大的零样本泛化能力。

Authors: Ziyan Wang, Dong Li, Weibo Wang, Yinyin Lu, Jiayu Xie, Jiamao Gu, Dongpeng Zhang

CASCADE: A Spatio-Temporal-Causal Reasoning Representation and Dataset for Driving AutonomousDriving

causal reasoning scene graph autonomous driving human-annotated dataset spatio-temporal reasoning

简要说明：CASCADE 提出了一种用于驾驶场景的结构化时空因果场景表示，并提供了一个人工标注的数据集，用于评估自动驾驶中的推理能力。

TLDR: CASCADE proposes a structured spatio-temporal-causal scene representation for driving and provides a human-annotated dataset for benchmarking reasoning in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Reasoning is a promising route to the generalization that autonomous driving requires in the long tail, as it can infer how the elements of a scene depend on one another and traverse those dependencies to conclusions beyond what is observed. Yet it is hard to tell whether a model's conclusions follow the scene's dependencies, because no driving representation makes them explicit enough to test against. Text-based reasoning traces lack spatio-temporal grounding, spatio-temporal scene graphs lack causal links, and reasoning annotations at scale are increasingly model-generated and hard to verify. To this end, we introduce CASCADE (Causal Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Driving Environments), which encompasses two components: (1) a structured scene representation for reasoning in driving scenes and (2) a human-annotated dataset built on it. For every actor that interacts with the ego vehicle, the CASCADE representation records frame-by-frame, for as long as the actor is visible, what action is taken, where it occurs, and how it depends on the actions and states of others. The resulting structure makes reasoning predictions machine-verifiable: they can be scored against it element by element, without relying on (M)LLM judges. The CASCADE dataset provides comprehensive human annotations for 2,066 driving clips of the PhysicalAI dataset, with over 34K elements that establish the spatio-temporal and causal context of each scene, including 8.6K time-stamped ego and agent actions, 3.7K causal links and 2.9K potential influences, and 6.1K annotations for agents, objects, traffic lights, and environments. Being entirely human-annotated, CASCADE provides the reference for this comparison: benchmarking the reasoning abilities of Physical AI models, and verifying the quality of automatically generated reasoning labels. The CASCADE dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/cascade.

摘要（中文）：推理是实现自动驾驶在长尾场景中所需泛化能力的一条有前途的路径，因为它能够推断场景中各元素之间的依赖关系，并沿着这些依赖关系推导出超出观察范围的结论。然而，我们很难判断模型的结论是否遵循场景中的依赖关系，因为现有的驾驶表征均未能使其足够明确以进行验证。基于文本的推理轨迹缺乏时空基础，时空场景图缺乏因果关联，而大规模推理标注越来越依赖模型生成且难以验证。为此，我们提出CASCADE（驾驶环境的因果时空分析），它包含两个组成部分：（1）一种用于驾驶场景推理的结构化场景表征，以及（2）基于该表征构建的人工标注数据集。对于每个与自车交互的动素，CASCADE表征会在其可见期间逐帧记录其所采取的动作、发生位置，以及该动作如何依赖于其他动素的行动与状态。由此产生的结构使得推理预测可被机器验证：无需依赖（多模态）大语言模型评判，即可逐元素对其进行评分。CASCADE数据集为PhysicalAI数据集的2,066段驾驶剪辑提供了全面的人工标注，包含超过34,000个元素，建立了每个场景的时空与因果语境，其中包括8,600个带时间戳的自车与动素动作、3,700条因果链接与2,900条潜在影响，以及6,100条关于动素、物体、交通信号灯及环境的标注。由于完全由人工标注，CASCADE为此类对比提供了基准：评估物理AI模型的推理能力，并验证自动生成推理标签的质量。CASCADE数据集可通过https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/cascade获取。

Authors: Jenny Schmalfuss, Despoina Paschalidou, Simon Gerstenecker, German Ros, Jose M. Alvarez

PhysReal: Learning Real-World Deformable Object Physics via Hybrid Constitutive Modeling WorldModel

deformable object physics hybrid constitutive modeling differentiable MPM simulator video-driven physics learning robotic downstream applications

简要说明：PhysReal通过混合本构模型与可微模拟器及渲染器，从视频中学习真实世界可变形物体的物理特性，实现动态重建和未来状态预测，助力机器人应用。

TLDR: PhysReal learns real-world deformable object physics from video by integrating a hybrid constitutive model with a differentiable simulator and renderer, enabling dynamic reconstruction and future-state prediction for robotics.

Abstract: Learning physically plausible dynamics from visual observations is essential for interactive world models and embodied agents. However, modeling real-world deformable objects remains challenging because their dynamics often arise from complex, spatially heterogeneous material responses. To address this challenge, we propose PhysReal, a video-driven framework for learning and simulating the underlying physics of real deformable objects. PhysReal integrates a spatially varying hybrid expert-neural constitutive model with a differentiable MPM simulator and 3DGS renderer. Analytical expert models provide interpretable physical priors, while neural constitutive residuals capture material responses beyond predefined formulations. Spatially distributed patches parameterize the constitutive field, enabling a continuous representation of local material variations. To organize the identification of this model from sparse visual observations, we adopt a progressive curriculum that sequentially optimizes global material properties, spatially varying local parameters, and neural constitutive residuals, together with complementary motion and mask supervision. Extensive experiments on diverse deformable-object interactions demonstrate that PhysReal achieves superior performance in dynamic reconstruction and future-state prediction, while showing strong potential for downstream robotic applications.

摘要（中文）：从视觉观测中学习物理上可信的动力学行为，对于交互式世界模型和具身智能体至关重要。然而，对真实世界可变形物体进行建模仍具挑战性，因为其动力学通常源于复杂且空间异质的材料响应。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PhysReal——一个基于视频的框架，用于学习并模拟真实可变形物体的底层物理特性。PhysReal将空间变化的混合专家-神经本构模型与可微分的MPM模拟器及3DGS渲染器相结合。解析专家模型提供了可解释的物理先验，而神经本构残差则能捕捉超出预定义公式的材料响应。空间分布的块状区域对本构场进行参数化，从而实现对局部材料变化的连续表征。为了从稀疏的视觉观测中组织这一模型的识别过程，我们采用了一种渐进式课程，依次优化全局材料属性、空间变化的局部参数以及神经本构残差，并辅以互补的运动与掩码监督。针对多种可变形物体交互行为的大量实验表明，PhysReal在动态重建与未来状态预测方面均实现了卓越性能，并展现出在下游机器人应用中的强大潜力。

Authors: Yinan Deng, Jianqiao Song, Yisi Zhang, Yuhan Wang, Jiahui Wang, Yufeng Yue

CosmoH2G: A Hand-to-Gripper Transfer Dataset and Baseline Method for Object Manipulation with Complex Spatial Movements Manipulation

hand-to-gripper transfer imitation learning keyframe prediction gripper pose generation complex spatial manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了CosmoH2G，一个包含复杂空间动作的大规模手到夹具配对数据集，并设计了一个两阶段框架（稀疏关键帧预测+完整动作生成）及后优化平移策略，以实现从人手演示到机器人夹具的复杂操作稳定迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces CosmoH2G, a large-scale hand-to-gripper paired dataset with complex spatial movements, and proposes a two-stage framework (sparse keyframe prediction + full action generation) with post-optimized translation to enable stable transfer of complex manipulations from human hand demonstrations to robotic grippers.

Abstract: Transferring human hand demonstrations to robotic grippers has recently emerged as a cost-effective solution for robot learning. However, existing methods are largely confined to simple, planar tasks and fail to handle complex spatial movements (e.g., intricate trajectories involving rotations or flips) that are essential for robot manipulation. Motivated by this gap, we adopt an implicit, data-driven approach guided by fine-grained hand-pose motions. To this end, we introduce a scalable acquisition pipeline to collect hand-gripper paired demonstrations, governed by a rigorous protocol that prioritizes motion complexity and leverages a handheld gripper for seamless action mimicry. This yields a large-scale paired dataset comprising 6,189 episodes across 1,254 unique objects, exhibiting significantly higher spatial complexity than existing benchmarks. However, learning such complex mappings remains challenging. We observe that naive end-to-end generation of full gripper pose sequences is insufficient, as minor trajectory deviations compound rapidly under intricate dynamics. To address this, we propose a two-stage framework: Stage I predicts sparse gripper keyframes (initial and terminal) to simplify the mapping objective, while Stage II generates the full continuous action sequence conditioned on these keyframes. Furthermore, to mitigate cumulative drift, we keep the gripper's orientation being learned while post-optimizing its translation based on the grasping heuristic and kinematic consistency. In both simulation and real-robot experiments, our framework enables stable and precise hand-to-gripper transfer of complex spatial manipulations, significantly outperforming traditional baselines. Project page: https://cosmoh2g.github.io.

摘要（中文）：将人类手部演示迁移至机器人夹爪，近期已成为一种经济高效的机器人学习方法。然而现有方法多局限于简单平面任务，难以处理机器人操作中至关重要的复杂空间运动（如涉及旋转或翻转的复杂轨迹）。基于这一研究空白，我们采用隐式数据驱动方法，以细粒度手部姿态运动为引导。为此，我们引入了可扩展的数据采集流程，通过严格协议约束以运动复杂度优先为原则，并利用手持式夹爪实现无缝动作模仿，从而收集手爪配对演示数据。该流程生成了包含1254个独特物体的6189个演示片段的大规模配对数据集，其空间复杂度显著高于现有基准。然而学习此类复杂映射仍具挑战：我们发现直接端到端生成完整夹爪姿态序列存在不足——在复杂动力学条件下，微小轨迹偏差会迅速累积放大。为此，我们提出两阶段框架：第一阶段预测稀疏夹爪关键帧（初始与终止位姿）以简化映射目标，第二阶段基于这些关键帧生成完整连续动作序列。此外，为减轻累积漂移，我们在保持夹爪朝向学习的同时，基于抓取启发式规则与运动学一致性对平移分量进行后优化。仿真与真实机器人实验表明，该框架能够稳定精确地实现复杂空间操作的手-夹爪迁移，显著优于传统基线方法。项目页面：https://cosmoh2g.github.io。

Authors: Hongxiang Zhao, Mutian Xu, Zeyu Jin, Yiming Hao, Shuguang Cui, Xiaoguang Han

Functional-SLAM: Interaction-Aware Mapping with Online Functional Scene Graphs Perception3D

functional 3D scene graphs online SLAM anchor-keyframe geometry functional-topology loop closure interaction-aware mapping

简要说明：Functional-SLAM提出了一种实时SLAM框架，通过结合锚点关键帧几何与功能上下文约束，在线构建并维护功能3D场景图，支持精细化的机器人交互。

TLDR: Functional-SLAM introduces a real-time SLAM framework that builds and maintains a functional 3D scene graph online by combining anchor-keyframe geometry with functional-context constraints, enabling fine-grained robotic interaction.

Abstract: Existing SLAM systems lack modeling of the functional relations required for fine-grained robotic interaction. Functional 3D scene graphs can represent relations between objects and interaction elements, but existing methods rely on offline reconstruction, making them inadequate for real-time interaction in real-world exploration. To address this limitation, we propose Functional-SLAM, the first framework that continuously and recursively maintains a functional scene graph as an online SLAM state. The framework combines anchor-keyframe geometry with functional-context constraints for persistent node maintenance, accumulates multi-frame evidence through temporal relations to commit stable functional edges, and supplements visual loop-closure candidates with functional topology in scenes with repetitive appearance or degraded texture. Experiments show that Functional-SLAM efficiently constructs stable functional maps online, substantially improving runtime over offline methods while maintaining highly competitive accuracy. Compared with peer SLAM systems, it further improves pose estimation accuracy through functional-topology-assisted loop closure. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Hbelief1998/Functional-SLAM-CoRL_2026.

摘要（中文）：现有SLAM系统缺乏对细粒度机器人交互所需功能关系的建模能力。功能三维场景图能够表达物体与交互元素之间的关联，但现有方法依赖离线重建，难以满足实际探索中的实时交互需求。针对这一局限，我们提出Functional-SLAM——首个将功能场景图作为在线SLAM状态进行持续递归维护的框架。该框架结合锚点关键帧几何与功能上下文约束实现持久节点维护，通过时序关系累积多帧证据以建立稳定功能边，并在外观重复或纹理退化场景中利用功能拓扑补充视觉闭环候选。实验表明，Functional-SLAM能在在线状态下高效构建稳定的功能地图，相比离线方法显著提升运行效率，同时保持高度竞争性的精度。与同类SLAM系统相比，其通过功能拓扑辅助闭环进一步提升了位姿估计精度。代码已开源：https://github.com/Hbelief1998/Functional-SLAM-CoRL_2026。

Authors: Xinggang Hu, Chenyangguang Zhang, Zihan Zhu, Ruida Zhang, Xiangkui Zhang, Xiangyang Ji

CALM: Configuration-Aware Human Intervention Boundaries During Robot Approach HumanoidEmbodied

human-robot interaction humanoid arm configuration proxemics intervention boundary eye-tracking study

简要说明：本论文研究人形机器人手臂配置如何影响人类在机器人接近过程中的停止距离和舒适度，提出了配置感知极限模型（CALM）以计算依赖于配置的干预边界。

TLDR: This paper studies how humanoid arm configuration affects human stopping distance and comfort during robot approach, proposing Configuration-Aware Limit Model (CALM) to compute configuration-dependent intervention boundaries.

Abstract: How robot body configuration shapes human intervention during approach remains underexplored. We conducted a within-participants study with 41 participants, measuring final stopping distance, subjective comfort, and exploratory eye-tracking responses across four humanoid arm configurations and two spatial scales. Full forward arm extension increased stopping distance by approximately 31-36 cm relative to arms-down. Spatial scale primarily affected comfort and pupil responses without a detectable stopping-distance shift. We introduce the Configuration-Aware Limit Model (CALM), which translates stopping-distance distributions into configuration-dependent population-coverage boundaries. Estimated boundaries at 80% coverage ranged from 0.88 to 1.47 m. In an illustrative one-dimensional planning analysis, reconfiguration enabled a 1.10 m approach goal that was unreachable with arms remaining fully extended under the same nominal pointwise 20% intervention-probability constraint. These findings support treating body configuration as a planning variable while distinguishing physical safety, behavioral intervention, and subjective cost.

摘要（中文）：机器人身体构型如何影响其靠近过程中的人类干预行为仍是一个尚未充分探究的问题。我们开展了一项含41名参与者的被试内研究，测量了四种仿人机械臂构型及两种空间尺度下的最终停止距离、主观舒适度及探索性眼动追踪反应。相较于手臂下垂状态，手臂完全前伸使停止距离增加约31-36厘米。空间尺度主要影响舒适度与瞳孔反应，但未检测到停止距离的显著变化。我们提出了"构型感知极限模型"，该模型将停止距离分布转化为依赖构型的人群覆盖边界。在80%覆盖率的条件下，估算边界范围为0.88至1.47米。在一项说明性的一维规划分析中，若机器人在相同的名义点状20%干预概率约束下保持手臂完全伸展状态，1.10米的接近目标原本不可达，但通过重新配置构型实现了该目标。这些发现支持将身体构型视为规划变量，同时区分物理安全、行为干预与主观成本。

Authors: Xinting Gao, Sipu Zhu, Weimin Zhuang

Generalizable 6D Pose Estimation of Textureless Objects with Planar-based Gaussian Splatting Manipulation

6D pose estimation textureless objects Gaussian Splatting pose optimization industrial robot grasping

简要说明：PG-Pose通过结合基于平面的高斯泼溅重建和几何驱动的位姿优化，无需CAD模型即可估计无纹理物体的6D位姿，在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上达到最优精度，并在双臂工业机器人上成功实现了抓取任务。

TLDR: PG-Pose estimates 6D poses of textureless objects without CAD models by combining planar-based Gaussian splatting reconstruction with geometry-driven pose optimization, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on the OnePose-LowTexture dataset and demonstrating successful grasping on a dual-arm industrial robot.

Abstract: Estimating the 6D pose of textureless objects without prior CAD models remains a critical challenge due to the lack of appearance features. While recent generalizable approaches alleviate the dependence on object-specific models, their performance on low-texture objects is often limited by insufficient geometric constraints in the underlying representations. In this work, we propose PG-Pose, a geometry-aware framework combining Planar-based Gaussian Splatting (PGS) reconstruction and Geometry-driven pose optimization. In the offline representation extraction stage, three distinct representations of the object are extracted from multi-view reference RGB images with known poses. PG-Pose reconstructs a 3D Gaussian representation and renders high-fidelity depth maps to generate 3D point clouds through back projection. In the online pose inference stage, the initial pose of the input image is estimated by 2D-3D correspondence matching between the input image and the reconstructed 3D point clouds, followed by a PGS-Refiner for iterative pose optimization. Evaluations on the OnePose-LowTexture datasets, PG-Pose achieves an average accuracy of 94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d, with a 2.1% improvement average accuracy compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) GS-based approach. To further demonstrate the effectiveness of PG-Pose for industrial robots in grasping tasks, we deploy it on a dual-arm industrial robot and successfully realize the grasping task on an unseen object.

摘要（中文）：针对无纹理物体在无先验CAD模型情况下的6D位姿估计，由于缺乏外观特征仍是一项严峻挑战。尽管近期提出的泛化方法减轻了对特定物体模型的依赖，但这类方法在低纹理物体上的性能常因底层表示中几何约束不足而受限。本文提出PG-Pose方法，该框架融合基于平面的高斯泼溅（PGS）重建与几何驱动位姿优化。在离线表征提取阶段，通过已知位姿的多视角参考RGB图像提取目标物体的三类独立表征。PG-Pose重建三维高斯表征并渲染高保真深度图，通过反投影生成三维点云。在线位姿推理阶段，通过输入图像与重建三维点云间的2D-3D对应匹配估计初始位姿，随后采用PGS-Refiner进行迭代位姿优化。在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上的评估显示，PG-Pose在ADD(S)@0.1d指标上达到平均94.2%的准确率，相较基于高斯泼溅的最先进（SOTA）方法平均准确率提升2.1%。为验证PG-Pose在工业机器人抓取任务中的有效性，我们将其部署于双臂工业机器人系统，成功实现了对未知物体的抓取作业。

Authors: Jie Lu, Hengtan Zhang, Li Gong, Pengpeng Wang, Xianjia Yu, Jinxiang Deng, Tomi Westerlund, Zhongxue Gan, Lirong Zheng, Zhuo Zou

Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in Surgical Manipulation Manipulation

phase-and-first-arrival feedback sparse-reward reinforcement learning surgical manipulation vision-language model credit assignment

简要说明：本文提出了一种阶段与首次到达反馈方法，通过VLM查询从记录的手术操作片段中识别最远完成的任务阶段及其首次到达时间，通过保留部分进展和定位信用来改善稀疏奖励强化学习。

TLDR: This paper introduces phase-and-first-arrival feedback, a method that uses VLM queries to identify the furthest completed task phase and its first arrival time from recorded surgical manipulation episodes, improving sparse-reward reinforcement learning by preserving partial progress and localizing credit.

Abstract: Sparse outcome feedback limits what robots can learn from unsuccessful attempts at complex manipulation. Failed multi-stage surgical attempts can contain grasps, lifts, or transfers worth reusing. In sparse-reward reinforcement learning, terminal rewards collapse such attempts to the same outcome, while scalar vision-language model (VLM) ratings reveal neither what progress merits credit nor when it occurred. We introduce phase-and-first-arrival feedback: one VLM query per recorded episode identifies the furthest visually verified task phase and when that phase is first reached, allowing the learner to reuse partial behavior and localize credit. We instantiate it in SurgPhaseBench, a phase-structured suite spanning rigid and deformable tasks, and evaluate it in simulation and hardware. Across five simulated tasks, our method reaches 75.2% mean success, compared with 52.1% for a reward based on Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) using the same visual input; the advantage persists when only the feedback representation changes. On hardware, the same record supports autonomous block picking and slip recovery. Together, these results show that trajectory-level visual supervision can preserve partial progress while providing the temporal credit needed for sparse-reward control.

摘要（中文）：稀疏结果反馈限制了机器人从复杂操作失败尝试中学习的能力。失败的多阶段手术尝试可能包含值得重复利用的抓取、提举或转移动作。在稀疏奖励强化学习中，终端奖励会将此类尝试归并为相同结果，而标量视觉-语言模型评分既无法揭示哪些进展值得归因，也无法表明其发生时间。我们提出了一种阶段-首次到达反馈机制：每记录一个回合，即通过一次视觉-语言模型查询来识别经视觉验证的最远任务阶段及其首次到达时刻，使学习者能够复用部分行为并定位信用分配。我们在SurgPhaseBench（一个涵盖刚体与可变形任务的阶段化任务套件）中实现了该方法，并在仿真与硬件环境中进行评估。在五个仿真任务上，我们的方法达到75.2%的平均成功率，而基于相同视觉输入的对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）奖励方法仅为52.1%；仅改变反馈表征方式时该优势依然存在。在硬件实验中，同一记录支持自主模块拾取与滑移恢复。这些结果表明，轨迹级视觉监督既能保留部分进展信息，又能提供稀疏奖励控制所需的时间信用分配。

Authors: Wanli Liuchen, Fangyuan Wang, Bin Li, Anqing Duan, Yunhui Liu, Peng Zhou, David Navarro-Alarcon

Human-Aware Target Tracking and Navigation: Fusing Kinematic State Estimation with Structural Map Constraints VLN

person-following target tracking occlusion recovery topological map navigation stack

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于人员跟随机器人的自主导航栈，融合视觉跟踪与激光雷达点聚类实现连续目标跟踪，并在遮挡时激活基于地图的恢复框架，通过图搜索和轨迹预测在最长7秒的遮挡期间维持跟随行为。

TLDR: This paper presents an autonomous navigation stack for person-following robots that fuses visual tracking and LiDAR point clustering for continuous target tracking and activates a map-based recovery framework with graph search and trajectory prediction to maintain follow behavior during occlusions of up to 7 seconds.

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots performing person-following tasks often suffer from temporary occlusions and sensor track loss in dynamic environments. This research presents an end-to-end autonomous navigation stack that addresses target occlusion through map-informed spatial reasoning. The proposed system features a multi-modal perception pipeline, fusing deep learning-based visual tracking with 2-dimensional LiDAR point clustering to maintain high-fidelity tracking of a tagged person. A continuous state estimator integrates this perception data with wheel odometry and IMU sensors for stable localization. When the active track is lost due to occlusion, the system activates a map-based recovery framework. Leveraging a predefined topological map, the system executes a graph-based search to propagate the target's last known trajectory along structurally defined walking lanes, adhering to left-hand regional conventions. By generating a discrete set of feasible future trajectories, the robot reasons about potential structural trajectory changes, such as continuing a heading or turning at an intersection. This map-informed prediction is fed directly to the local obstacle avoidance planner, enabling the robot to continue following its target safely and predictably until the person is visually reacquired. Real-world evaluations in dense multi-person environments demonstrate the system's robustness, achieving a 71.4\% target reacquisition success rate during major occlusion events lasting up to 7 seconds.

摘要（中文）：自主移动机器人在执行人员跟随任务时，常因动态环境中的临时遮挡和传感器跟踪丢失而受限。本研究提出了一种端到端的自主导航架构，通过地图引导的空间推理解决目标遮挡问题。该系统采用多模态感知流水线，融合基于深度学习的视觉跟踪与二维激光雷达点聚类技术，实现对被标记人员的高保真跟踪。连续状态估计器将感知数据与轮式里程计及IMU传感器相结合，实现稳定定位。当主动跟踪因遮挡丢失时，系统激活基于地图的恢复框架。利用预定义的拓扑地图，系统执行基于图的搜索，沿结构化的行走通道（遵循左侧通行区域惯例）传播目标的最后已知轨迹。通过生成一组离散的可行未来轨迹，机器人能够推理潜在的结构性轨迹变化（如保持当前航向或在交叉路口转弯）。这种基于地图的预测直接馈送至局部避障规划器，使机器人在重新视觉捕获目标前能够安全且可预测地持续跟踪。在密集多人员环境中的实际测试表明，该系统具备鲁棒性，在持续长达7秒的重大遮挡事件中实现了71.4%的目标重新捕获成功率。

Authors: Sagar Gupta, Don Gideon, Seng W. Loke, Kevin Lee, Bijo Sebastian

Mind the Phase: Effective Rank and Representation Health in Legged Locomotion Locomotion

effective rank policy Jacobian legged locomotion sim-to-real transfer representation health

简要说明：本文研究了腿部运动策略中策略雅可比的有效秩，发现将秩条件化在步态相位上能揭示架构结构，并提出一种方法将模拟到真实的迁移平滑性提升约3倍，降低关节抖动。

TLDR: This paper studies the effective rank of the policy Jacobian in legged locomotion policies, revealing that conditioning rank on gait phase exposes architectural structure and proposes a recipe to improve sim-to-real transfer smoothness by approximately 3x lower joint jitter.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the leading paradigm in legged locomotion, enabling complex behaviors from backflips to parkour through massively parallel simulation. Under PPO's non-stationarity, shallow networks remain the de facto architecture, supported by carefully staged curricula and environments, yet the representations these policies learn stay poorly understood, leaving no training-time signal of how they will behave on hardware. In this work, we empirically study locomotion policies through the effective rank of the policy Jacobian and show that conditioning rank on the gait phase exposes architectural structure that global rank averages away. In particular, we find that standard architectural choices, namely layer normalization and residual connections, allocate roughly two more dimensions of effective rank to swing than to stance, which is fully absent in vanilla MLPs. Building on this, we propose a simple recipe that turns these representational signatures into smoother, more reliable sim-to-real transfer. In practice, this results in roughly 3x lower joint jitter that holds from simulation onto a physical Spot, suggesting that representation health is an effective training-time lens to track sim-to-real smoothness.

摘要（中文）：强化学习已成为足式运动领域的主导范式，通过大规模并行仿真使机器人能够实现从后空翻到跑酷等复杂行为。在PPO算法的非平稳特性下，浅层网络配合精心设计的分阶段课程与环境仍是最主流的架构选择，然而这些策略所习得的表征机制尚不明确，导致在训练过程中无法预知策略在硬件上的实际表现。本研究通过策略雅可比矩阵的有效秩对运动策略进行实证分析，发现基于步态相位对秩进行条件化处理时，能够揭示被全局秩平均化的架构特征。具体而言，标准架构选择（层归一化与残差连接）为摆动相分配的有效秩维度比支撑相多出两个维度，而这一特性在传统多层感知机中完全不存在。基于此发现，我们提出了一种简单方法，将这些表征特征转化为更平滑、更可靠的仿真到现实迁移方案。实验表明，该方法在从仿真环境到物理Spot机器人的迁移过程中，可降低约3倍的关节抖动幅度，证实表征健康度可作为追踪仿真到现实迁移平滑性的有效训练时标。

Authors: Felipe Tommaselli, Thiago H. Segreto, Juliano D. Negri, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker

Distributed Dexterous Manipulation with Spatially Conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers Manipulation

Distributed Dexterous Manipulation Multi-Agent Transformers spatial contrastive embeddings behavior cloning Soft Actor Critic

简要说明：提出了一种基于空间条件多智能体Transformer的框架，用于学习由64个软体Delta机器人组成的分布式灵巧操作系统的鲁棒控制策略，实现约1.5厘米误差同时减少约65%的机器人使用。

TLDR: A framework using spatially conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers to learn robust control policies for distributed dexterous manipulation with an 8x8 grid of soft delta robots, achieving ~1.5 cm error while using ~65% fewer robots.

Abstract: Distributed Dexterous Manipulation (DDM) is a novel paradigm that presents significant control challenges due to high action-space redundancy, inter-robot cooperation, and dynamic object-robot interactions. This paper introduces a framework based on spatially conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers (MATs) to efficiently learn robust control policies for a DDM system grounded in an array of 64 soft delta robots arranged in an 8x8 grid. Our three core contributions are: (i) an MAT with adaptive layer norm for compute efficiency, (ii) spatial contrastive embeddings to ground transformer embeddings in the spatial configuration of the robots, and (iii) an MAT-based behavior cloning method fine-tuned using Soft Actor Critic. We also propose an action selection formulation to analyze the trade-off between task performance and the number of robots utilized. Our experiments show that MATs iteratively refine their actions through the stacked attention blocks. This further informs the benefit of spatial conditioning in transformers to learn DDM policies. We demonstrate long-horizon planar manipulation tasks with objects of various geometries in simulation and real-world. Finally, we show how action selection mitigates robot maintenance by reducing wear and tear due to inter-robot collisions while maintaining the ability to manipulate objects along various trajectories in the real-world, achieving an average error of ~1.5 cm, while using ~65% fewer robots.

摘要（中文）：分布式灵巧操控(DDM)是一种新颖范式，由于高动作空间冗余、机器人间协作以及动态的物体-机器人交互，它带来了显著的控制挑战。本文提出一个基于空间条件化多智能体Transformer(MAT)的框架，用于高效学习基于8×8网格中64台软体Delta机器人构成的DDM系统的鲁棒控制策略。我们的三项核心贡献是：(i) 采用自适应层归一化提升计算效率的MAT；(ii) 利用空间对比嵌入将Transformer嵌入与机器人的空间构型相结合；(iii) 基于MAT的行为克隆方法，并通过软演员-评论家算法进行微调。我们还提出一种动作选择公式，用于分析任务性能与所用机器人数量之间的权衡。实验表明，MAT通过堆叠的注意力模块迭代优化其动作，这进一步揭示了Transformer中空间条件化对学习DDM策略的益处。我们在仿真和真实世界中演示了针对多种几何形状物体的长时域平面操控任务。最后，我们展示动作选择如何通过减少机器人间碰撞造成的磨损来降低维护需求，同时保持沿不同轨迹操控物体的能力，在真实世界中实现了约1.5厘米的平均误差，且机器人使用量减少约65%。

Authors: Sarvesh Patil

Solution for UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection AutonomousDriving

Sim-to-Real LiDAR 3D Object Detection RangeLDM DSVT PointPillars

简要说明：本文针对城市驾驶中的仿真到真实激光雷达三维物体检测，通过将合成数据对齐到真实测试分布并使用集成检测器与类别感知融合，在UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI挑战中取得了最高分。

TLDR: This paper addresses sim-to-real LiDAR 3D object detection for urban driving by aligning synthetic data to real test distributions and using ensemble detectors with class-aware fusion, achieving top scores in the UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI challenge.

Abstract: We present our solution to the LUMPI track of the UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge at the 6th DriveX Workshop, ECCV 2026. The detector must be trained only on synthetic data and is evaluated on 50 held-out real LiDAR frames; a separate 50-frame synthetic submission is evaluated for point-cloud realism. Our method addresses the Sim2Real gap at three levels. First, we align synthetic scans to the 50k-point test density and build a 30k-record training pool using UT-LUMPI geometry, RangeLDM-based sampling diversification, rare-class copy-paste, and pedestrian-oriented augmentation. Second, complementary DSVT detectors and Car/Bus PointPillars specialists are trained under the same synthetic-only constraint. Third, predictions are integrated by class-aware routing, asymmetric agreement fusion, constrained residual-recall supplementation, class-coverage auditing, and selective box-size calibration. The realism branch is optimized independently with radial-density matching, weak affine calibration, and calibrated set mixing. The final submission obtains a Combined Score of 0.4692, a Detection Score of 0.1797, a Realism Score of 0.9035, and 3D mAP@0.5 of 0.1258.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了在ECCV 2026第六届DriveX研讨会的UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛LUMPI赛道中的解决方案。检测器必须仅使用合成数据进行训练，并在50帧保留的真实激光雷达数据上进行评估；另外，针对点云真实感，提交了50帧独立合成数据的评估结果。我们的方法从三个层面解决Sim2Real差距。首先，我们将合成扫描数据对齐到5万点测试密度，并利用UT-LUMPI几何结构、基于RangeLDM的采样多样化、稀有类别的复制粘贴以及面向行人的增强技术，构建了一个包含3万条记录的训练池。其次，在相同的仅含合成数据的约束条件下，训练了互补的DSVT检测器以及Car/Bus专用PointPillars模型。最后，通过类别感知路由、非对称一致性融合、受限残差召回补充、类别覆盖审计以及选择性框尺寸校准来整合预测结果。真实感分支通过径向密度匹配、弱仿射校准和校准集混合独立优化。最终提交结果获得了0.4692的综合分数，检测分数为0.1797，真实感分数为0.9035，3D mAP@0.5为0.1258。
