Authors: Pu Luo, Cong Xu, Yumei Li, Kexin Zhang, Licheng Jiao, Wenping Ma, Lingling Li

World Models Under Asynchronous Sensor Observations WorldModel

asynchronous sensor observations world models staleness time-to-refresh transformer world models

简要说明：本文研究世界模型如何处理异步传感器观测，通过使用陈旧度和刷新时间特征，发现这些特征的有效性取决于采样计划是否对系统产生因果影响。

TLDR: This paper investigates how world models can handle asynchronous sensor observations by using staleness and time-to-refresh features, finding that the effectiveness of these features depends on whether the sampling schedule causally affects the system.

Abstract: Learned world models typically assume that observations arrive synchronously, an abstraction inherited from simulators that return a complete state vector at each environment step. Physical sensing instead operates at heterogeneous rates, leaving most observation channels stale at any given instant. Interpolating stale channels introduces measurements that were never observed, while downsampling to the slowest sensor discards valid measurements. A natural alternative is to zero-order-hold the most recent reading and provide the known sampling schedule to the model through two features, staleness and time-to-refresh. We test this prediction using transformer world models across three regimes of increasing causal coupling: open-loop rollouts in continuous-control locomotion, closed-loop model-predictive planning in which each learned model serves as the planner dynamics, and a linear latched-actuator system in which refresh events apply a zero-order-held command to the plant. Our findings show that the effectiveness of time-to-refresh depends on the causal role of the sampling schedule, specifically when refresh events affect the system rather than merely report its state. These results establish when sampling schedules provide useful information for predictive world models operating under asynchronous physical observations.

摘要（中文）：学习型世界模型通常假设观测值是同步到达的，这一抽象概念继承自仿真器——仿真器在每个环境步骤中都会返回完整的状态向量。然而，物理感知以实现不同速率运行，导致大多数观测通道在任意给定时刻都处于陈旧状态。对陈旧通道进行插值会引入从未被实际观测到的测量值，而将采样率降至最慢传感器则会丢弃有效测量值。一种自然的替代方案是采用零阶保持器保留最新读数，并通过两个特征——陈旧度与刷新时间——将已知的采样调度信息提供给模型。我们使用Transformer世界模型，在因果耦合程度递增的三种场景下测试了这一预测：连续控制运动中的开环 rollout、每个学习模型作为规划动态的闭环模型预测规划、以及一个线性锁存执行器系统（在该系统中，刷新事件将零阶保持指令施加于被控对象）。我们的研究发现表明，刷新时间的有效性取决于采样调度的因果作用，具体而言，当刷新事件影响系统而非仅仅报告其状态时更有效。这些结果确立了在异步物理观测条件下，采样调度何时能为预测性世界模型提供有用信息。

Authors: Akash Anand, Abhay Anand, Yash Vishe

SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons AutonomousDriving

spatiotemporal trajectory prediction vehicle platoons string stability physics-constrained learning causal attention

简要说明：SSP-DMGTimeNet 是一个物理约束学习框架，通过引入弦稳定性损失来改进车辆队列轨迹预测，在保持预测精度的同时确保扰动传播的稳定性。

TLDR: SSP-DMGTimeNet is a physics-constrained learning framework that improves vehicle platoon trajectory prediction by enforcing string stability losses, achieving accurate yet disturbance-stable predictions.

Abstract: Existing car-following prediction methods mainly optimize trajectory accuracy, while rarely considering whether predicted disturbances propagate realistically along a vehicle platoon. This limitation may lead to accurate but string-unstable predictions. We propose SSP-DMGTimeNet, a physics-constrained learning framework for spatiotemporal trajectory prediction of vehicle platoons. The model combines multi-scale temporal representations with cross-vehicle interaction features to capture complex and time-varying platoon dynamics. A propagation-delay-aware causal attention mechanism explicitly models upstream-to-downstream disturbance propagation by learning response delays between adjacent vehicles and accumulating them along the platoon. In addition, time- and frequency-domain string-stability losses relieve disturbance amplification across both adjacent vehicles and arbitrary sub-platoons during training. Experiments on HighD show that SSP-DMGTimeNet achieves an unstable-window rate of 0.65\% for five-vehicle platoons and a maximum head-to-tail amplification of 0.898 on the ground-truth excitation subset, while maintaining competitive trajectory prediction performance. In zero-shot evaluation on NGSIM US-101 and I-80, the model achieves velocity MAEs of 1.316~m/s and 1.252~m/s, with unstable-window rates of 3.90\% and 4.10\%, respectively. These results demonstrate that incorporating platoon-level physical constraints can effectively balance trajectory prediction accuracy and disturbance propagation stability.

摘要（中文）：现有的跟车预测方法主要优化轨迹精度，却鲜少考虑预测的扰动能否沿车队真实传播。这一局限可能导致高精度预测出现串不稳定现象。我们提出SSP-DMGTimeNet——一种物理约束下的车队时空轨迹预测学习框架。该模型融合多尺度时间表征与跨车辆交互特征，捕捉车队复杂时变动力学特性。通过传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制，模型学习相邻车辆间的响应延迟并沿车队累积，从而显式建模上游至下游的扰动传播。此外，时域与频域的串稳定性损失函数在训练过程中可抑制相邻车辆及任意子车队的扰动放大效应。在HighD数据集上的实验表明：对于五车车队，SSP-DMGTimeNet的不稳定窗口率仅0.65%，在真实激励子集上最大头尾放大系数达0.898，同时保持具有竞争力的轨迹预测性能。在NGSIM US-101与I-80数据集上的零样本评估中，模型速度MAE分别为1.316米/秒与1.252米/秒，不稳定窗口率各为3.90%与4.10%。这些结果表明，引入车队级物理约束可有效平衡轨迹预测精度与扰动传播稳定性。

Authors: Yuhang Wang, Kailang Ma, Zirui Li, Mingfeng Fan, Kitae Jang, Changju Lee, Heye Huang

Solution for UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection AutonomousDriving

Sim2Real LiDAR 3D object detection class-aware fusion multi-source training UrbanTwin

简要说明：提出多源协同训练与类别感知融合框架，融合数字孪生、扩散重绘、密度稳定和形态对齐的激光雷达扫描数据，提升路边LiDAR在自动驾驶中的仿真到真实3D目标检测性能。

TLDR: A multi-source collaborative training and class-aware fusion framework that uses digital-twin, diffusion-redrawn, density-stabilized, and morphology-aligned LiDAR scans to improve sim-to-real 3D object detection for roadside LiDAR in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in roadside LiDAR requires addressing several coupled discrepancies, including scene geometry, sampling density, return patterns, and pedestrian scale. This report presents a multi-source collaborative training and class-aware fusion framework for Sim2Real 3D detection. The method organizes digital-twin scans, diffusion-redrawn scans, density-stabilized scans, and pedestrian morphology-aligned samples into a unified training pool with complementary roles. Within a common DSVT detection formulation, source-specialized expert branches preserve those roles while optimizing for the same detection objective. At inference, a predefined class-aware fusion pathway integrates geometry-stable and calibration-aware branches for vehicles, sampling-complementary branches for trucks, and morphology-consistent evidence for pedestrians. A label-free point-cloud center blend then refines geometric localization. On the UrbanTwin V2X-Real hidden test set, the unified system achieves a combined score of 0.7421, with 3D mAP@0.5 of 0.4518 and a realism score of 0.8871. The results indicate that a stable, interpretable collaboration among data sources is more valuable than unconstrained aggregation of model outputs.

摘要（中文）：缩小路边激光雷达仿真与现实差距需要解决若干耦合差异，包括场景几何结构、采样密度、回波模式及行人尺度。本文提出一种面向Sim2Real三维检测的多源协同训练与类别感知融合框架。该方法将数字孪生扫描、扩散重绘扫描、密度稳定化扫描及行人形态对齐样本组织成具有互补角色的统一训练池。在通用DSVT检测架构中，各来源专精的专家分支在保持各自功能角色的同时，针对同一检测目标进行优化。推理阶段，预定义的类别感知融合路径为车辆整合几何稳定分支与标定感知分支，为卡车整合采样互补分支，为行人整合形态一致性证据。随后通过无标签点云中心融合优化几何定位。在UrbanTwin V2X-Real隐藏测试集上，该统一系统综合得分为0.7421，3D mAP@0.5达到0.4518，真实感得分为0.8871。结果表明，数据源间稳定可解释的协作比模型输出的无约束聚合更具价值。

Authors: Pu Luo, Cong Xu, Yumei Li, Kexin Zhang, Licheng Jiao, Wenping Ma, Lingling Li

NutriBench-Kitchen: Benchmarking Embodied AI for Nutrition Management VLN

Embodied Nutrition Management long-video agent food-state tracking knowledge-grounded planning benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了NutriBench-Kitchen，一个用于动态厨房环境中具身营养管理的基准测试，以及具有显式记忆模块的诊断性智能体Nutri-Vgent，揭示了大型视觉语言模型在持续状态追踪和约束感知推理方面与人类表现的显著差距。

TLDR: This paper introduces NutriBench-Kitchen, a benchmark for embodied nutrition management in dynamic kitchen environments, along with Nutri-Vgent, a diagnostic agent with explicit memory modules, revealing significant gaps between LVLMs and human performance in persistent state tracking and constraint-aware reasoning.

Abstract: An embodied kitchen assistant must do more than recognize food in isolated frames. It must track ingredient states over time and integrate visual observations with recipe and nutritional knowledge to support constraint-aware decision-making. We formalize this capability as \emph{Embodied Nutrition Management}: perceiving nutrition-relevant events, maintaining a persistent food state, and using it for knowledge-grounded planning. Existing benchmarks evaluate static food understanding or embodied cooking actions, but do not measure whether an agent can continuously update and use nutrition-relevant states in dynamic kitchens. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{NutriBench-Kitchen}, a benchmark containing 1,500 manually verified question--answer pairs from 160 cooking videos. It covers five task families: Ingredient Entry, Memory Management, Recipe Query, Long-Term Planning, and Short-Term Planning, spanning food-state construction, maintenance, knowledge retrieval, and decision-making across different planning horizons. Evaluations of proprietary and open-source large vision-language models reveal a substantial gap from human performance, particularly in quantitative ingredient estimation, long-term state tracking, and reasoning under interacting constraints. We further introduce \textbf{Nutri-Vgent}, a diagnostic long-video agent with separate episodic, food-state, and recipe memories. Its consistent improvements demonstrate the value of explicit state representations and structured memory for nutrition management. Together, NutriBench-Kitchen and Nutri-Vgent provide a testbed for studying persistent state tracking and knowledge-grounded reasoning in dynamic kitchens. Code is available at https://github.com/V1ol1n/NutriBench-Kitchen.

摘要（中文）：具身厨房助手不能仅能识别孤立帧中的食物，还必须能够持续追踪食材状态变化，并将视觉观察与食谱及营养知识相结合，以支持约束感知的决策制定。我们将这种能力形式化为**具身营养管理**：感知营养相关事件、维持持久化的食物状态，并基于此进行知识驱动的规划。现有基准测试评估了静态食物理解或具身烹饪动作，但并未衡量智能体能否在动态厨房中持续更新并利用营养相关状态。为填补这一空白，我们提出了**NutriBench-Kitchen**基准，包含来自160段烹饪视频的1500个经人工验证的问答对。该基准涵盖五大任务族：食材录入、记忆管理、食谱查询、长期规划与短期规划，涉及食物状态构建、维护、知识检索以及跨不同规划周期的决策制定。对专有与开源大型视觉语言模型的评估显示，其与人类表现存在显著差距，尤其在食材定量估计、长期状态追踪及交互约束下的推理方面。我们进一步提出**Nutri-Vgent**——一种诊断性长视频智能体，配备独立的情节记忆、食物状态记忆和食谱记忆。其持续的性能提升证明了显式状态表示与结构化记忆对营养管理的价值。NutriBench-Kitchen与Nutri-Vgent共同为研究动态厨房中的持久状态追踪与知识驱动推理提供了测试平台。代码已开源：https://github.com/V1ol1n/NutriBench-Kitchen。

Authors: Yulin Wei, Xiangchen Wang, Jianhui Pan, Jinyu Xiao, Zheng Tan, Ruozai Tian, Guanhua Chen, Feng Zheng

A Two-Stage Framework for Ego-Centric Key Object Identification via Object State Prediction AutonomousDriving

virtual ego-vehicle object state prediction spatial-temporal reasoning key object identification autonomous driving

简要说明：一个两阶段框架，通过虚拟自车表示和物体状态预测结合时空推理，在自动驾驶中识别关键物体。

TLDR: A two-stage framework that uses a virtual ego-vehicle representation and object state prediction with spatial-temporal reasoning to identify key objects in autonomous driving.

Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework designed to enhance key object identification in autonomous driving. Existing methods primarily focus on either detecting objects independently or leveraging visual relationships, but they do not explicitly consider the ego vehicle's perspective in determining object importance. To address this gap, we propose a structured approach that integrates a virtual ego-vehicle representation and a modular object state predictor, enabling a more accurate estimation of object behaviors relative to the ego-vehicle. Subsequently, our framework employs spatial-temporal reasoning to refine key object identification, prioritizing objects based on their states and relative spatial information rather than relying solely on visual relationships. Experimental results on real-world driving datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in accurately detecting critical objects in complex traffic environments.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种新颖的框架，旨在提升自动驾驶中关键目标的识别能力。现有方法主要侧重于独立检测目标或利用视觉关系，但并未显式考虑自车视角对目标重要性的判定。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种结构化方法，该方法集成了虚拟自车表征与模块化目标状态预测器，从而能够更准确地估计目标相对于自车的运动状态。在此基础上，本框架通过时空推理优化关键目标识别，依据目标状态及相对空间信息（而非仅依赖视觉关系）对目标进行优先级排序。基于真实驾驶数据集的实验结果表明，该方法在复杂交通环境中能有效检测关键目标。

Authors: Shihong Ling, Yue Wan, Xiaowei Jia, Na Du

Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception WorldModel

temporal perception world model multimodal intelligence generative video pretraining open-world perception

简要说明：本文提出通用开放世界时序感知架构（GOWTPA），将感知、预测和合成视为共享生成式视频预训练基座的不同条件，旨在作为多模态智能与物理AI的基础层。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception Architecture (GOWTPA) that frames perception, prediction, and synthesis as different conditionings of a shared generative video-pretrained substrate, aiming to serve as a foundation layer for multimodal intelligence and physical AI.

Abstract: The next generation of artificial intelligence systems will likely be natively temporal and multimodal in both inputs and outputs: able to converse, perceive, predict, reason, and synthesize through a shared world representation. Realizing this requires a temporal perceptual substrate integrating sensory streams, language, and structured outputs within a multimodal world model. We seek a generalist open-world perceptual system that represents biological forms, natural physical structures, and artifacts, and their interactions, as a coherent, temporally persistent process. The model should infer geometry, articulation, semantics, interaction structure, and uncertainty from raw multimodal streams; maintain identity through occlusion and viewpoint change; generalize across species, forms, mechanisms, and materials; and abstain or expand its ontology when encountering the unknown. The objective is a structured world state supporting understanding, prediction, counterfactual reasoning, and controllable synthesis. Recent work suggests that some cross-modal and reasoning-like capabilities can emerge from large-scale generative video pretraining, reminiscent of language-model scaling. Yet these capabilities are often accessed through language probes or expressed through photorealistic video, leaving explicit semantic, geometric, or temporal structure largely unexposed. This paper articulates an alternative and complementary paradigm: perception and synthesis as distinct conditionings within a shared Generalist Open-World Temporal Perception Architecture (GOWTPA). Recognition, structured prediction, and simulation arise as different conditionings of the same generative substrate, while reasoning and embodiment-specific policies build upon the resulting world state. This positions generalist temporal perception as a potential foundation layer for broader multimodal intelligence and physical AI.

摘要（中文）：下一代人工智能系统很可能在输入和输出上都是天然时间性与多模态的：能够通过共享的世界表征进行对话、感知、预测、推理与合成。实现这一目标需要一个时间感知基板，在多模态世界模型内整合感觉流、语言和结构化输出。我们寻求一种通用的开放世界感知系统，将生物形态、自然物理结构、人造物及其交互，表征为一个连贯且具有时间持续性的过程。该模型应从原始多模态流中推断几何、关节、语义、交互结构及不确定性；在遮挡和视角变化下保持身份一致性；在不同物种、形态、机制和材料间泛化；并在遇到未知事物时放弃或扩展其本体。其目标是一个支持理解、预测、反事实推理和可控合成的结构化世界状态。近期研究表明，某些跨模态及类推理能力可从大规模生成式视频预训练中涌现，这令人联想到语言模型的规模效应。然而，这些能力往往通过语言探针获取或通过逼真视频表达，而明确的语义、几何或时间结构大多未被揭示。本文阐述了一种替代且互补的范式：将感知与合成视为共享的通用开放世界时间感知架构（GOWTPA）内的不同条件作用。识别、结构化预测与仿真作为同一生成基板的不同条件作用出现，而推理及具身特定策略则在此基础上构建世界状态。这将通用时间感知定位为更广泛的多模态智能与物理人工智能的潜在基础层。

Authors: Cristian Sminchisescu

TrojanWorld: Backdooring World-Model Agents via Imagination Steering WorldModel

backdoor attack world model imagination steering supply chain threat model-based reinforcement learning

简要说明：TrojanWorld 提出了一种针对世界模型代理的后门攻击框架，通过物理触发器操纵其内部想象，实现隐蔽且持久的控制，同时保持高清洁性能。

TLDR: TrojanWorld proposes a backdoor framework that attacks world-model agents by steering their internal imagination via physical triggers, achieving stealthy and persistent control while maintaining high clean performance.

Abstract: World models increasingly serve as the predictive core of model-based reinforcement learning agents, enabling them to simulate future dynamics and reason over imagined trajectories before acting. Their substantial training demands make pretrained world models attractive for distribution and reuse, exposing downstream systems to model supply chain threats. Backdoor attacks offer a targeted and stealthy means of exploiting such supply chains, yet their threat to interactive world-model agents remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present TrojanWorld, a backdoor framework for world-model agents that induces attacker-specified behavior by steering internal imagination. A physical object placed in the scene acts as the trigger, enabling deployment-time activation through the agent's native observation pipeline without digitally manipulating the observation stream. To achieve effective, stealthy, and persistent control, TrojanWorld combines Decision-Reflective Induction to steer trigger-conditioned imagination toward attacker-specified actions using decision feedback, Clean Behavior Anchoring to preserve trigger-free predictive and behavioral fidelity, and Causal Propagation to sustain the induced preference along subsequent trajectories after the trigger disappears. Together, these mechanisms establish an end-to-end attack chain from physical perception through corrupted imagination to malicious action selection. Experiments with the TD-MPC2, DreamerV3, and R2-Dreamer systems across the DeepMind Control, MetaWorld, MyoSuite, and RoboDesk benchmarks show that under trigger activation, TrojanWorld achieves a target-action deviation as low as 0.026 while retaining at least 98.8% of the corresponding clean performance. Even after trigger removal, the compromised agent can remain trapped in the induced behavioral trajectory, continuing to execute attacker-specified actions.

摘要（中文）：世界模型日益成为基于模型的强化学习智能体的预测核心，使其能够在行动前模拟未来动态并推理想象轨迹。由于其训练需求庞大，预训练世界模型在分发与复用过程中具有吸引力，这导致下游系统面临模型供应链威胁。后门攻击提供了一种针对性强、隐蔽性高的供应链利用手段，但其对交互式世界模型智能体的威胁仍鲜有研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出TrojanWorld——一种针对世界模型智能体的后门框架，通过操控内部想象诱导攻击者指定的行为。场景中放置的物理对象作为触发器，可通过智能体原生的观测通道在部署阶段激活，无需对观测数据流进行数字篡改。为实现高效、隐蔽且持久的控制，TrojanWorld融合了决策反射归纳（利用决策反馈将触发条件想象引导至攻击者指定行为）、清洁行为锚定（保持无触发器时的预测与行为保真度）以及因果传播（在触发器消失后沿后续轨迹维持诱导偏好）三种机制。这些机制共同构建了从物理感知经污染想象到恶意动作选择的端到端攻击链。在TD-MPC2、DreamerV3及R2-Dreamer系统上，基于DeepMind Control、MetaWorld、MyoSuite和RoboDesk基准的实验表明：在触发器激活条件下，TrojanWorld实现了低至0.026的目标动作偏差，同时保持至少98.8%的对应清洁性能。即便在触发器移除后，被攻陷的智能体仍可困于诱导行为轨迹中，持续执行攻击者指定的动作。

Authors: Wenkai Huang, Siyuan Liang, Gaolei Li, Yiming Li, Tianhao Peng, Jianhua Li, Dacheng Tao

BinauralVAE: Spatial Audio Reconstruction For World Models WorldModel

spatial audio reconstruction Variational Autoencoder binaural signals audio-based world model embodied AI

简要说明：BinauralVAE 提出了一种使用 VAE 变体进行空间音频重建的管道，配合模拟器获取声学数据，旨在为具身智能体实现基于音频的世界模型。

TLDR: BinauralVAE introduces a pipeline for spatial audio reconstruction using VAE variants, developed alongside a simulator for acoustic data, aiming to enable audio-based world models for embodied agents.

Abstract: Embodied artificial intelligence has historically very much relied on visual perception, leading to a proliferation of multiple vision-centric world models. However, this reliance fails to capture spatial understanding in its entirety and can even present vulnerabilities in environments with visual occlusions, low-light conditions, or blackouts-scenarios, where acoustic information becomes a critical alternative for spatial awareness and navigation. Despite its potential, research into realistic spatial audio and particularly the development of audio-centric world models remains sparse. In this technical report, we introduce BinauralVAE: a flexible, open-source pipeline (https://github.com/Luizerko/BinauralVAE) that explores multiple models for spatialized audio reconstruction, progressing from fundamental baselines to advanced, mathematically grounded architectures. Our approach evaluates various Variational Autoencoder architectures -- including complex-valued variants -- to learn robust latent representations of binaural signals. Developed alongside AudioWorldSim, our methodology leverages realistic acoustic data captured as a simulated robot navigates an environment. This pipeline establishes a foundation for state representation in a future audio-based world model, designed to map the direct causal connection between navigational actions and their resulting acoustic consequences, and helping to enable sound as an essential complementary modality for spatial knowledge acquisition.

摘要（中文）：具身人工智能历来高度依赖视觉感知，导致多种以视觉为中心的世界模型不断涌现。然而，这种依赖关系无法完整捕捉空间理解，甚至在视觉遮挡、弱光或断电等场景中暴露出脆弱性——在这些情况下，声学信息成为空间感知与导航的关键替代方案。尽管潜力巨大，但针对现实空间音频，尤其是以音频为中心的世界模型开发的研究仍较为匮乏。本技术报告介绍BinauralVAE：一个灵活的开源流水线（https://github.com/Luizerko/BinauralVAE），它探索了多种用于空间化音频重建的模型，从基础基线逐步推进至具有数学基础的先进架构。我们的方法评估了多种变分自编码器架构（包括复数变体），以学习双耳信号的鲁棒潜在表征。该方法与AudioWorldSim协同开发，利用模拟机器人在环境中导航时采集的真实声学数据。该流水线为未来基于音频的世界模型中的状态表征奠定基础，旨在建立导航动作与其声学结果之间的直接因果映射，助力声音成为空间知识获取的关键补充模态。

Authors: Luis Vitor Zerkowski, Luiz Velho

P$^2$Calib: Utilizing Pattern Priors for LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration Perception3D

LiDAR-camera calibration pattern priors extrinsic calibration multi-sensor fusion geometric constraints

简要说明：提出一种利用目标板CAD模型中的图案先验（圆孔半径和刚性矩形布局）来提升激光雷达-相机外参标定精度的方法，相比标准四孔方法显著降低了重投影误差。

TLDR: Proposes a LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration method that uses pattern priors (hole radius and rigid rectangular layout) from a CAD model to substantially improve calibration accuracy over the standard four-hole approach.

Abstract: Target-based LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration is a prerequisite for multi-sensor fusion in robotics. However, in the widely adopted four-hole pipeline, calibration accuracy is bottlenecked by LiDAR-side hole-center extraction, which suffers from sparse angular coverage and mixed-pixel corruption. This paper presents P$^2$Calib, which exploits pattern priors, geometric constraints specified by the CAD model of the target board, to improve calibration accuracy. First, we incorporate the known hole radius as a fitting constraint to prevent center estimates from degrading under sparse angular coverage. Building on the improved hole estimates, we further enforce the rigid rectangular layout of the four holes as a global consistency constraint to correct residual errors across holes. Both priors are integrated into an interactive calibration tool that provides a complete extrinsic calibration pipeline. Experiments on simulated and real datasets show that P$^2$Calib lowers the joint registration residual by 90\% and 82\% and the held-out reprojection error by 96\% and 77\% over the baseline. Code, https://github.com/JokerJohn/P2Calib.git, and data will be released to facilitate future research.

摘要（中文）：基于目标的激光雷达-相机外参标定是机器人多传感器融合的前提条件。然而，在广泛采用的四孔标定板流程中，标定精度受限于激光雷达侧的孔心提取，该过程存在角点稀疏覆盖与混合像素干扰的问题。本文提出P$^2$Calib方法，利用标定板CAD模型定义的图案先验与几何约束提升标定精度。首先，我们将已知的孔半径作为拟合约束，避免角点稀疏覆盖导致的孔心估计退化。在改进的孔心估计基础上，进一步将四孔刚性矩形布局作为全局一致性约束，修正跨孔残余误差。两种先验被集成至交互式标定工具中，形成完整的外参标定流程。在仿真与真实数据集上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，P$^2$Calib将联合配准残差降低90%与82%，保留重投影误差降低96%与77%。代码（https://github.com/JokerJohn/P2Calib.git）与数据将开源以促进后续研究。

Authors: Xiangcheng Hu

SMaRT-Tug: Structured Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Based Tugboat-Barge Collaborative Manipulation Manipulation

multi-agent reinforcement learning decentralized MAPPO structured control prior physics-based simulation tugboat manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于GPU加速的物理仿真和结合结构化控制先验的分散式MAPPO框架，用于多拖船协作操纵驳船，在性能上优于PID和集中式基线方法。

TLDR: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated physics-based simulation and a decentralized MAPPO framework with a structured control prior for multi-tugboat collaborative manipulation of barges, demonstrating improved performance over PID and centralized baselines.

Abstract: Autonomous tugboating is central for automating maritime operations such as port logistics and vessel maneuvering, where multiple tugboats must cooperatively transport/manipulate a larger vessel. Collaborative pushing in this setting is challenging due to coupled hydrodynamics, low resistance, strong environmental disturbances, underactuated barge dynamics, and contact-rich interactions. Conventional control methods often rely on simplified models and fixed configurations, which limit their adaptability, while learning-based approaches are constrained by the lack of scalable and physically realistic training environments. We address these challenges by introducing a physics-based, GPU-accelerated simulation and learning framework for collaborative tugboat manipulation. Our simulator incorporates a customized buoyancy model, wave modeling, and hydrodynamic resistance, and supports large-scale multi-agent training under marine dynamics. In this simulator, we train a decentralized MAPPO (Multi-Agent PPO) policy augmented with a structured control prior (SCP) to improve training stability and maintain feasible pushing configurations. We evaluate our learned policy on straight-line transit, turning, and deceleration tasks, where we show that our decentralized framework yields more reliable and accurate maneuvering performance compared to a PID-based controller and a centralized PPO baseline. We further demonstrate zero-shot generalization to more challenging sea states and advanced maneuvers, as well as zero-shot scalability to larger teams of three and four tugboats despite training with only two agents.

摘要（中文）：自主拖船操作是自动化港口物流和船舶操纵等海上作业的核心，其中多艘拖船需协同运输/操控大型船舶。在此场景下，协同推顶因耦合水动力学、低阻力、强环境扰动、欠驱动驳船动力学及富含接触的交互特性而具有挑战性。传统控制方法通常依赖简化模型与固定构型，限制了其适应性；而基于学习的方法则受限于缺乏可扩展且物理真实的训练环境。为解决这些难题，我们提出了一种基于物理的GPU加速仿真与学习框架，用于协同拖船操控。该模拟器集成了定制浮力模型、波浪建模及水动力学阻力，支持海洋动力学条件下的大规模多智能体训练。在此模拟器中，我们训练了一种去中心化MAPPO（多智能体PPO）策略，并引入结构化控制先验以提升训练稳定性并维持可行的推顶构型。我们在直线航行、转向和减速任务上评估了所学策略，结果表明：与基于PID的控制器及集中式PPO基线相比，我们的去中心化框架能实现更可靠、更精准的操纵性能。此外，我们验证了该方法在更具挑战性的海况与高级操纵任务中的零样本泛化能力，且尽管仅使用两个智能体训练，仍能零样本扩展至三艘和四艘拖船的更大编队。

Authors: Junkai Lu, Jiadong Zhao, Jiacheng Zhang, Wenqi Zhao, Hao Gen Chia, Qun Shen Png, Germaine Ee, Chengyang He, Yifeng Zhang, Nathanael Tan, Guillaume Sartoretti

Open-Set Ego-Noise Separation for Legged-Robot Audition via Annotation-Free Adaptation and Pretrained-Model Transfer Locomotion

ego-noise separation annotation-free adaptation RecurGraph Transfer-DiT legged-robot audition

简要说明：提出一种框架，通过 RecurGraph 自动选取自噪声主导片段并利用 Transfer-DiT 适配预训练分离器，无需人工标注即可消除足式机器人录音中的自噪声。

TLDR: Proposes a framework that adapts a pretrained neural separator to remove ego-noise from legged-robot audio recordings without manual annotation, using RecurGraph to automatically select ego-noise-dominant clips and Transfer-DiT for adaptation.

Abstract: This paper proposes an open-set ego-noise separation framework for legged-robot audition via annotation-free adaptation and pretrained-model transfer. The framework removes robot-specific ego-noise while preserving environmental sounds whose classes are not specified in advance. Acoustic sensing provides cues about a robot's surroundings beyond the visual field, but walking-induced ego-noise from footstep impacts, joint-backlash rattling, and motor noise severely contaminates the recordings. The framework first uses RecurGraph to select ego-noise-dominant clips from the unlabeled recordings by aggregating clip embeddings into an embedding centroid and propagating scores over an audio-embedding graph. The selected clips are mixed with diverse environmental sounds from a large-scale sound-event dataset to provide paired mixture--target supervision for open-set separation. Transfer-DiT then adapts a general-purpose zero-shot neural separator to achieve high-fidelity open-set ego-noise separation for the target robot. Experiments with bipedal and quadrupedal robots show reliable clip selection and improvements in separation quality and downstream task performance over baseline separators. These results demonstrate the feasibility of annotation-free adaptation without separately recorded ego-noise-only data or manual clip-level annotations.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种面向足式机器人听觉的开放集自噪声分离框架，通过免标注自适应与预训练模型迁移实现。该框架可在保留未预先指定类别环境声音的同时，消除机器人特有的自噪声。声学感知能提供视野范围外的机器人环境线索，但行走引起的足部撞击声、关节间隙颤振声及电机噪声会严重污染录音。该框架首先采用RecurGraph方法：通过将片段嵌入聚合为质心，并基于音频嵌入图传播分数，从未标注录音中选取自噪声主导片段。随后将所选片段与大规模声音事件数据集中的多样化环境声音混合，为开放集分离提供配对混合-目标监督。Transfer-DiT进而对通用零样本神经分离器进行自适应，实现目标机器人的高保真开放集自噪声分离。在双足与四足机器人上的实验表明，该框架在片段选取可靠性、分离质量及下游任务性能上均优于基线分离器。这些结果证实了无需单独录制自噪声数据或手动片段级标注即可实现免标注自适应的可行性。

Authors: Koki Shoda, Jun Younes Louhi Kasahara, Aoba Koyanagi, Qi An, Atsushi Yamashita

Distributed Secure Learning Control for Large-scale Multirobots under Stealthy Actuator Attacks Other

distributed secure learning control multirobot systems stealthy actuator attacks reinforcement learning DMPC

简要说明：本文提出一种分布式安全学习控制框架，将强化学习与分布式模型预测控制相结合，抵御大规模多机器人系统中的隐秘执行器攻击，并通过仿真和真实轮式机器人实验验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a distributed secure learning control (DSLC) framework that integrates reinforcement learning with distributed model predictive control to defend against stealthy actuator attacks in large-scale multi-robot systems, validated in simulations and real-world wheeled robot experiments.

Abstract: Distributed learning control for multirobot systems (MRS) offers significant flexibility in presence of uncertainties but lacks provable performance guarantees. A promising direction involves integrating reinforcement learning (RL) into distributed model predictive control (DMPC), leveraging the strengths of RL in nonlinear policy design and the receding-horizon replanning capabilities of DMPC. However, ensuring secure control within such a learning framework under malicious cyber attacks, particularly stealthy ones, remains a critical challenge, because the distributed policies generation depends on information exchange among neighbors, where compromised agents can rapidly influence the behavior of others through the communication network. This article proposes a distributed secure learning control (DSLC) framework for large-scale MRS under malicious, stealthy actuator attacks. Our framework offers two key features: (i) a unified approach that enables secure learning control across various coordination scenarios and (ii) a game-theoretic distributed learning-based predictive control strategy that learns how to balance the attacker and defender through a differential-game based DMPC framework. Specifically, DSLC employs a distributed attacker-actor-critic architecture to learn the optimal defense and attack policies online within each prediction interval. Unlike numerical optimization-based controllers that calculate open-loop control sequences, our method simultaneously generates adversarial attack policies and corresponding defense policies in analytical closed-loop form. The defense policies could be directly generalized to MRS with varying scales and diverse actuator attack probabilities. The effectiveness and scalability of DSLC are validated through comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments in multiple wheeled robots via various control tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 多机器人系统（MRS）的分布式学习控制在存在不确定性的情况下具有显著灵活性，但缺乏可验证的性能保障。一个具有前景的方向是将强化学习（RL）集成到分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）中，结合RL在非线性策略设计中的优势与DMPC的滚动时域重规划能力。然而，在恶意网络攻击（尤其是隐蔽攻击）下确保此类学习框架的安全性仍是一项关键挑战，因为分布式策略的生成依赖于邻居间的信息交互，而受损智能体可通过通信网络迅速影响其他智能体的行为。本文针对大规模MRS在恶意隐蔽执行器攻击下的场景，提出了一种分布式安全学习控制（DSLC）框架。该框架具备两个关键特性：（i）一种统一方法，可在多种协调场景下实现安全学习控制；（ii）一种基于博弈论的分布式学习预测控制策略，通过基于微分博弈的DMPC框架学习如何平衡攻击者与防御者。具体而言，DSLC采用分布式攻击者-行动者-评论家架构，在每个预测区间内在线学习最优防御与攻击策略。与计算开环控制序列的数值优化控制器不同，我们的方法以解析闭环形式同时生成对抗攻击策略与相应的防御策略。该防御策略可直接推广至不同规模和多样化执行器攻击概率的MRS。通过多轮式机器人系统在多种控制任务下的综合仿真与真实实验，验证了DSLC的有效性与可扩展性。

Authors: Xinglong Zhang, Qingwen Ma, Cong Li, Hui Yin, Changxin Zhang, Yueying Wang, Wei Pan, Xin Xu

Predictive-Coding-Based Autonomous Regulation of Internally Generated and Externally Coupled Processing in Human-Robot Interaction Other

predictive coding variational recurrent neural network human-robot interaction meta-prior reconstruction error

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于预测编码的机制，使用变分递归神经网络（PV-RNN）在物理人机交互中调节内部生成预测与外部感觉证据之间的平衡，并展示了累积的重构误差可作为在线调整这种平衡的内源性信号。

TLDR: This paper proposes a predictive-coding-based mechanism using a variational recurrent neural network (PV-RNN) to regulate the balance between internally generated predictions and external sensory evidence during physical human-robot interaction, and shows that accumulated reconstruction error can serve as a signal for adjusting this balance online.

Abstract: Predictive coding characterizes adaptive behavior as a dynamic balance between internally generated predictions and external sensory evidence, yet how an embodied cognitive system can regulate this balance online during ongoing interaction remains poorly understood. This study proposes a predictive-coding-based mechanism for regulating internally generated and externally coupled processing during physical human--robot interaction. The framework employs a predictive-coding-inspired variational recurrent neural network (PV-RNN), in which a meta-prior controls the degree to which posterior inference is constrained by learned prior dynamics. We extend this architecture with an online mechanism that uses reconstruction error accumulated over recent interaction history to select between predefined meta-prior regimes. The mechanism was evaluated across three physical human--robot interaction tasks involving fixed structured, changing structured, and less-constrained interaction. Across all tasks, lower meta-prior values produced the expected increase in posterior--prior divergence and reduction in reconstruction error. More importantly, reconstruction-history-driven regime selection was also associated with reduced prospective prediction error and robot-side physical interaction conflict, demonstrating consequences beyond the retrospective reconstruction objective itself. Task~3 further showed that recent sensory observations can be successfully accommodated while subsequent human motion still departs from the model's prior-generated future trajectory. Overall, these findings show that accumulated reconstruction mismatch can provide an endogenous signal for regulating how strongly subsequent inference relies on learned internal dynamics relative to ongoing sensory input during embodied interaction.

摘要（中文）：预测编码将自适应行为刻画为内部生成的预测与外部感官证据之间的动态平衡，然而具身认知系统在持续交互过程中如何实时调节这一平衡仍未被充分理解。本研究提出一种基于预测编码的机制，用于调节人机物理交互中内部生成过程与外部耦合加工过程。该框架采用基于预测编码思想的变分递归神经网络（PV-RNN），其中元先验控制后验推断受习得先验动态约束的程度。我们在该架构中扩展了一种在线机制，通过积累近期交互历史的重构误差来选择预定义的元先验模式。该机制在涉及固定结构、变化结构及弱约束交互的三项人机物理交互任务中进行了评估。在所有任务中，较低的元先验值均导致预期的后验-先验差异增大与重构误差降低。更重要的是，基于重构历史驱动的模式选择还与前瞻性预测误差降低及机器人侧物理交互冲突减少相关联，表明其影响超越了回溯性重构目标本身。任务三进一步表明，在后续人体运动偏离模型先验生成的未来轨迹时，近期感官观测仍能被成功容纳。总体而言，这些发现表明，累积的重构失配可作为内源性信号，用于调节后续推断在多大程度上依赖习得的内部动态而非持续的感官输入。

Authors: Henrique Oyama, Hiroki Sawada, Jun Tani

Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

diffusion policies offline reinforcement learning policy gradient noisy-space Q-function KL-regularized policy improvement

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对离线强化学习中扩散策略的噪声空间策略梯度方法，通过引入噪声空间Q函数和KL正则化回归目标，避免了通过去噪过程的反向传播。

TLDR: This paper proposes a noisy-space policy gradient (NSPG) method for training diffusion policies in offline reinforcement learning, introducing a noisy-space Q-function and a KL-regularized regression objective that avoids backpropagation through the denoising process.

Abstract: Diffusion policies offer a powerful and expressive parameterization for continuous control. Yet, their integration with reinforcement learning remains conceptually and algorithmically challenging. In this work, we address this gap by introducing a noisy-space action-value (Q-)function that assigns values to diffusion latents through the distribution of executed actions induced by the denoising process. We show that this construction admits a precise semantic interpretation and derive a noisy-space policy gradient (NSPG) that optimizes noisy latents using only clean action-space value estimates. Building on this result, we formulate a KL-regularized policy improvement over noisy latents and show that the resulting objective admits a diffusion-compatible regression form, avoiding backpropagation through the denoising process. Empirical results on state-based D4RL benchmarks and vision-based OGBench tasks demonstrate that the proposed noisy-space objective provides a principled and effective basis for training diffusion policies in offline reinforcement learning. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/NSPG/

摘要（中文）：扩散策略为连续控制提供了一种强大且富有表现力的参数化方法。然而，其与强化学习的结合在概念和算法上仍面临挑战。在本工作中，我们通过引入一种噪声空间动作-价值（Q-）函数来弥合这一差距，该函数通过去噪过程所引发的已执行动作的分布，为扩散潜变量赋予价值。我们证明了这一构造具有精确的语义解释，并推导出噪声空间策略梯度（NSPG），该方法仅利用干净动作空间的价值估计来优化噪声潜变量。基于这一结果，我们在噪声潜变量上构建了KL正则化的策略改进，并证明了由此产生的目标函数可转化为与扩散过程兼容的回归形式，从而避免了通过去噪过程进行反向传播。在基于状态的D4RL基准测试和基于视觉的OGBench任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的噪声空间目标函数为离线强化学习中训练扩散策略提供了原则性且有效的基础。项目网页：https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/NSPG/

Authors: Mahmoud Selim, Cristina Cipriani, Karl H. Johansson

Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models VLN

contextual observer grounding spatial reasoning vision-language models 3D scenes point-of-view

简要说明：本文提出了POVBench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型从上下文线索推断说话者视角并进行情境空间推理能力的基准测试，发现即使最先进的VLM也难以处理这种上下文观察者定位。

TLDR: This paper introduces POVBench, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models' ability to infer a speaker's perspective from contextual cues and perform situated spatial reasoning in 3D scenes, finding that even state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with such contextual observer grounding.

Abstract: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.

摘要（中文）：在具身任务（如机器人技术）中基于语言指令进行推理，通常需要从说话者的情境视角理解空间关系。人类依靠共享的环境知识、活动背景和常识来推断此类视角。当前的视觉-语言模型（VLM）虽展现出空间推理能力，但尚不明确它们能否从语境线索中推断说话者的视角，并据此理解情境化的空间关系。我们称这种能力为"情境观察者定位"。为研究此能力，我们构建了视角基准数据集（POVBench），该数据集包含3D场景和查询，能够解耦自然具身交流中观察者定位的推断型、陈述型和给定型三种形式。给定多视角观察结果及自然语言句子后，模型需根据情境空间线索和语境线索定位未直接可见或描述不充分的目标。实验表明，即使明确给出观察者定位信息，当前最先进的VLM在基于方向性语言定位目标时仍面临挑战。我们发现，将观察者相对空间推理显式分解可提升目标定位效果。项目页面参见 https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/。

Authors: Mimo Shirasaka, Haochen Zhang, Yonatan Bisk

Diagnosing and Dynamically Filtering Occupancy World Models for Active Mapping Perception3D

occupancy world models active mapping dynamic filtering viewpoint selection 3D reconstruction

简要说明：本文诊断了占用世界模型错误如何影响主动建图性能，并提出了一种动态过滤策略，利用在线观测抑制误检，从而改善视角选择。

TLDR: This paper diagnoses how occupancy world model errors affect active mapping performance and proposes a dynamic filtering strategy to improve viewpoint selection by suppressing false positives using online observations.

Abstract: Active mapping requires a robot to select camera viewpoints that efficiently reconstruct an unknown 3D scene. To reason about unobserved regions, recent systems use pretrained occupancy networks as world models that complete missing geometry. The predicted structure contributes to expected coverage gain and constrains feasible robot motion. Consequently, occupancy errors can change both what the robot chooses to explore and where it is able to move. We diagnose these effects by holding the planner fixed and varying only the occupancy representation provided to it. We consider planning without completion, with learned occupancy, with false positives removed by a ground truth oracle, with false negatives restored by an oracle, and with ground truth occupancy. Our experiments show that correcting false positives or false negatives alone does not consistently improve final coverage. This finding reveals a gap between occupancy accuracy and downstream planning performance. Ground truth occupancy provides a much larger improvement in coverage efficiency than in endpoint coverage, suggesting that planning and reachability remain important bottlenecks even when the geometric world model is accurate. Based on these findings, we introduce a dynamic filtering strategy that preserves predictions in unexplored space while suppressing repeatedly unsupported occupancy using online observations. Preliminary examples show that this strategy can redirect viewpoint selection toward reachable surfaces that would otherwise remain unobserved.

摘要（中文）：主动建图要求机器人选择能高效重建未知三维场景的相机视角。为推理未观测区域，现有系统采用预训练的占用网络作为世界模型来补全缺失几何结构。预测的结构有助于提升预期覆盖增益，并约束可行的机器人运动。因此，占用误差既会影响机器人选择探索的内容，也会影响其可移动的范围。我们通过固定规划器、仅改变提供给规划器的占用表征来诊断这些影响。我们考虑了以下场景：无补全规划、基于学习占用规划、由地面真值预言机去除假阳性、由预言机恢复假阴性，以及基于地面真值占用规划。实验表明，单独修正假阳性或假阴性并不能持续改善最终覆盖效果。这一发现揭示了占用精度与下游规划性能之间的差距。地面真值占用对覆盖效率的提升远大于对终点覆盖率的提升，这表明即使在几何世界模型精确的情况下，规划与可达性仍是重要的瓶颈。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种动态过滤策略：在保留未探索空间预测的同时，利用在线观测抑制反复出现且缺乏支撑的占用估计。初步实例表明，该策略能够将视角选择重新导向那些原本未被观测但可达的表面。
